All employment decisions are made based on qualifications, merit, and business needs. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

·       Strong written and verbal communication skills

Curious Builders

Accountable High Performers

Passion for Impact

Remote Project Manager – Kitchen & Bath Remodeling

Kitchen Tune-Up & Bath Tune-Up

Remote Position Supporting North Atlanta, Georgia Projects

Compensation: $12 per hour | Full-Time, 50 Hours per Week

Benefits

Performance-based bonuses
Long-term career advancement opportunities
Remote work
Opportunity to grow with an expanding remodeling company

Create Raving Fans & Make Money!

Kitchen Tune-Up and Bath Tune-Up is seeking an experienced Remote Project Manager
to coordinate residential kitchen and bathroom remodeling projects throughout North Atlanta.

This is a full-time remote position for someone who can successfully coordinate 10-20 active remodeling projects simultaneously
while maintaining exceptional standards for scheduling, client communication, documentation, material ordering, quality control, project cycle times, and budget performance.

Our goal is straightforward: Create Raving Fans & Make Money!

The right candidate has strong experience managing U.S. residential kitchen and bathroom remodeling projects. They are highly organized, proactive, detail-oriented, comfortable holding installers and trade partners accountable, and committed to doing things the right way—even when no one is watching.

Compensation

$12 per hour
50 hours per week
Performance-based bonuses tied to measurable results, including:
Client satisfaction and 5-star Google reviews
On-time project completion and cycle times
Budget and gross-margin performance
Accurate and timely material ordering
Project documentation and communication
Minimal delays, rework, callbacks, and warranty issues

Opportunity for increased responsibility and career advancement based on performance

What You’ll Do

You will report to the Operations Manager and remotely coordinate multiple residential remodeling projects from pre-construction preparation through final completion.

Project Management and Scheduling

Coordinate 10-20 active kitchen and bathroom remodeling projects simultaneously
Review project scopes, plans, measurements, selections, specifications, budgets, and schedules before construction begins
Confirm that field measurements and site conditions have been properly documented before materials are ordered
Develop, maintain, and update realistic project schedules
Coordinate installers, trade partners, vendors, deliveries, inspections, and homeowners
Confirm daily installer attendance, progress, and next steps
Identify potential delays, missing materials, or cost overruns early and develop corrective action plans
Keep projects moving efficiently while minimizing downtime between construction phases
Ensure work remains within the approved scope and budget
Track pre-construction walks, start dates, countertop templating, installations, inspections, final walkthroughs, punch lists, completion dates, and outside dates
Protect project gross margin by actively managing labor, materials, change orders, rework, and scheduling

Material Ordering and Production Coordination

Review approved proposals, plans, selections, and measurements before ordering
Prepare and maintain detailed material lists and project-ordering trackers
Coordinate the ordering of cabinetry, cabinet-refacing materials, countertops, tile, plumbing fixtures, hardware, lighting, and related products
Confirm order acknowledgments, lead times, delivery dates, quantities, specifications, and finishes
Track whether materials have been ordered, received, inspected, and assigned to the correct project
Communicate proactively regarding backorders, damaged products, missing materials, and substitutions
Coordinate deliveries with vendors, Field Supervisors, installers, and clients
Help prevent ordering errors, jobsite delays, duplicate purchases, and unnecessary expedited-shipping costs

Quality Control and Documentation

Review daily jobsite photographs, videos, installer reports, and project updates
Confirm that completed work appears consistent with the approved scope, plans, selections, and Kitchen Tune-Up standards
Escalate potential quality concerns to the Field Supervisor or Operations Manager immediately
Maintain accurate project notes, schedules, photographs, documents, and communications in company systems
Track open items, deficiencies, punch-list work, callbacks, and warranty issues through completion
Help reduce rework by identifying inconsistencies, missing information, and potential problems early
Confirm that every project has complete and organized documentation

Client Experience

Provide homeowners with timely and professional project updates
Set clear expectations regarding schedules, upcoming work, required decisions, deliveries, and project milestones
Communicate proactively—especially when challenges, changes, or delays arise
Respond promptly and professionally to client questions and concerns
Coordinate project walkthroughs and ensure punch-list items are documented and resolved
Help create Raving Fans who confidently recommend Kitchen Tune-Up and leave 5-star Google reviews

Installer, Trade Partner, and Team Coordination

Build productive working relationships with installers, trade partners, vendors, and internal team members
Communicate daily with field personnel regarding attendance, progress, materials, quality, and upcoming work
Hold installers and trade partners accountable for schedules, communication, documentation, and commitments
Confirm that installers submit required jobsite photographs, videos, time records, and daily reports
Communicate project risks, delays, client concerns, and resource needs to the Operations Manager
Participate in daily project huddles, production meetings, operations meetings, and client calls
Prepare clear meeting notes, action items, deadlines, and follow-up communications
Follow through until every assigned task and project issue is fully resolved

Budget and Change-Order Management

Monitor project budgets, labor costs, material expenses, and gross-margin performance
Compare proposed work with actual field conditions and client requests
Identify work that falls outside the approved proposal
Prepare change-order information for management review before additional work begins
Track approved change orders and confirm that they are incorporated into schedules and project documentation
Help prevent unauthorized work, unapproved material purchases, and avoidable cost overruns

What Success Looks Like

The Remote Project Manager will be evaluated on their ability to help us Create Raving Fans & Make Money
, including:

Projects completed on schedule
Accurate and continuously updated project schedules
Projects completed within budget and gross-profit targets
Timely and accurate material ordering
Minimal ordering mistakes, delays, rework, callbacks, and warranty claims
Client satisfaction and 5-star Google reviews
Proactive client and team communication
Complete and accurate project documentation
Installer and trade-partner accountability
Fast identification and resolution of project risks
Ability to manage 10-20 active projects without sacrificing quality, client care, or profitability
Consistent ownership, responsiveness, and follow-through

Qualifications

Required

At least 3 years of project-management experience involving U.S. residential construction or remodeling
Direct experience managing kitchen, bathroom, cabinetry, or residential renovation projects
Demonstrated ability to coordinate more than five active projects simultaneously
Strong knowledge of U.S. residential construction methods, terminology, and sequencing
Working knowledge of cabinetry, countertops, tile, plumbing, electrical, flooring, and finish carpentry
Experience reviewing plans, measurements, scopes of work, specifications, and product documentation
Experience coordinating materials, installers, subcontractors, vendors, and project schedules
Strong understanding of quality control, job costing, change orders, and gross-margin management
Excellent written and spoken English
Strong organizational, problem-solving, and conflict-resolution skills
Ability to communicate professionally with U.S. homeowners, installers, vendors, and team members
Strong computer skills and the ability to learn new software quickly
Reliable computer, high-speed internet connection, headset, webcam, and distraction-free home workspace
Ability to remain available and responsive throughout scheduled working hours
Three professional supervisor references

Preferred

Experience with high-end residential remodeling
Experience working remotely for a U.S. construction or remodeling company
Experience with Buildertrend, ServiceMinder, 2020 Design, Microsoft Excel, Google Workspace, Zoom, or comparable systems
Experience ordering cabinetry, refacing materials, countertops, tile, plumbing fixtures, and remodeling products
Experience managing more than 10 active remodeling projects simultaneously
Bilingual English/Spanish communication skills
Relevant construction, design, estimating, or project-management education or certifications

Schedule

Full-time: 50 hours per week
Monday through Saturday
Must be available during the company’s required working hours in the U.S. Eastern Time Zone
Attendance at daily huddles, production meetings, operations meetings, and client calls is required
Occasional evening availability may be required based on client or project needs
This is a remote position, but it requires consistent availability, professional communication, and active engagement throughout the workday

Who Thrives Here

You May Be a Strong Fit If You:

Take complete ownership and follow through
Hold yourself and others accountable at an A-player level
Notice details others miss
Communicate problems early instead of allowing surprises
Respond promptly and understand that radio silence is unacceptable
Respect clients, teammates, installers, trade partners, and their time
Remain calm, resourceful, and solutions-focused under pressure
Can manage multiple priorities without losing track of details
Understand that excellent client service and profitable operations go hand in hand
Always strive to do the right thing
Want to build a long-term career with a growing remodeling company

About Kitchen Tune-Up

Kitchen Tune-Up provides kitchen remodeling and improvement solutions designed to transform clients’ homes while delivering an exceptional customer experience.

We believe remodeling should improve both the beauty of a home and the lives of the people who live there. We combine thoughtful planning, excellent craftsmanship, proactive communication, and disciplined project management to deliver outstanding results.

Our Operating Principles

Client Experience: Treat every homeowner and home with care, honesty, and respect.
Quality: Deliver craftsmanship we are proud to stand behind.
Ownership: Take responsibility for results and solve problems proactively.
Communication: Keep clients and teammates informed—no surprises and no radio silence.
Discipline: Protect schedules, budgets, margins, and company resources.
Continuous Improvement: Learn from every project and continuously improve our systems.
Purpose & Profit: Create Raving Fans & Make Money! Create exceptional value for clients while building a profitable, strong, and sustainable business.

Apply Today

Please Submit:

Your résumé
A brief summary of your U.S. kitchen and bathroom remodeling experience
A list of the project-management and construction software you have used
Your internet speed and home-office setup
Three professional supervisor references

Qualified applicants should be prepared to discuss specific projects they have managed, the number of simultaneous projects they coordinated, and examples of how they protected schedules, budgets, quality, and client relationships.

jobs.description:
About Coursera + Udemy

Coursera and Udemy are now one company, bringing together two mission-driven brands to create the world’s most powerful platform for turning learning into progress. Together, we help more than 300 million learners and 12,000+ enterprise customers build the skills they need for a world being reshaped by AI. Read more about the combined company by visiting our blog.

Why join us now?

AI is transforming how people learn, work, and grow, and the need for new skills has never been greater. Coursera brings trusted content and credentials from leading university and industry partners, while Udemy brings a dynamic skills marketplace and global network of real-world experts. By combining these strengths, we can connect more people and organizations to the skills they need, when they need them.

Shape What Comes Next

By joining our team, you’ll have the opportunity to reshape how the world learns and applies skills—and help millions of people participate in the new economy. Bring your ideas, expertise, and perspective to meaningful work that can make a difference at global scale.

Coursera + Udemy lets you choose the best way to work, whether it’s from home, an office, or a collaboration space. We’re a globally distributed team that comes together intentionally for collaboration, complex problem-solving, and key milestones — creating opportunities for teams to come together. If you’re ready to make a global impact, help scale unique products across Coursera + Udemy, and grow your career, apply below.

About this role:

The Marketing Strategy and Operations team at Coursera partners with all areas of the marketing organization and the enterprise sales team to drive revenue, design and execute marketing strategies, and lead internal processes to enhance productivity, leverage, and efficiency.

As the Creative Operations Program Manager, you will be the primary architect of the systems and processes that power Coursera’s creative output. You will manage the complex interplay of creative demand from marketing and product stakeholders, the execution capacity of our internal creative teams, and the strategic support of our external agency partners. Your goal is to establish a best-in-class operational model that ensures high-quality, distinctive creative work is delivered on budget and on time through effective cross-functional governance and resource optimization.

About your skills:

Collaboration — You build trust across marketing, product, and creative teams, and know how to align competing priorities into a single shared roadmap. You'll be the connective tissue between stakeholders and the creative teams delivering their work.
Systems Thinking — You see workflows end-to-end, not just in pieces. You'll design and refine the processes — from intake to final delivery — that keep creative work moving smoothly across internal teams and external agency partners.
Resourcefulness — You know how to make the most of limited capacity, balancing internal bandwidth against agency support to keep projects on track without sacrificing quality or blowing the budget.
Data-Driven Communication — You translate operational detail and performance metrics into clear, compelling updates — whether you're briefing a creative team or reporting up to senior leadership.

What you’ll be doing:

Workflow Architecture: Design, implement, and audit end-to-end creative workflows—from unified intake and brief grooming to final delivery—ensuring streamlined handoffs between marketing, product, and creative teams.
Program/Project Leadership: Lead complex, cross-functional creative initiatives from intake through delivery, driving timelines, dependency management, stakeholder alignment, risk mitigation, and launch readiness across marketing, product, and external partners.
Change Management: Drive adoption of new workflows, tools, and operating models through documentation, training, and stakeholder enablement.
Resource & Agency Management: Lead quarterly and weekly resource planning, balancing internal team bandwidth with a varied roster of external agencies to ensure optimal workload distribution and cost efficiency. Proactively identify capacity constraints and recommend prioritization, staffing, or agency engagement strategies to mitigate delivery risks and maintain execution quality.
Stakeholder Governance: Orchestrate cross-functional interlocks and steering meetings to align marketing/product objectives with creative capabilities, effectively communicating project tradeoffs and resource availability.
MarTech Optimization: Serve as the functional lead for the creative technology stack (e.g., Asana, DAM systems), integrating operational efficiencies into the ticketing and asset management processes.
Performance Tracking: Establish KPI frameworks and dashboards to track creative throughput, quality, and business impact, providing regular strategic updates to senior management.
Vendor Relations: Manage external agency contracts, renewals, and onboarding in partnership with Procurement and Legal, ensuring all partners adhere to Coursera’s brand and quality standards.

Qualifications:

5+ years of experience as a Creative Producer, Program Manager, or Project Manager working directly with high-volume creative teams.
Demonstrated experience managing resource planning, budget mitigation, and external agency relationships within a marketing or product organization.
Expert-level proficiency in project management tools (e.g., Asana, Jira, or Airtable) and experience building automated workflows within these systems.
Proven history of leading cross-functional collaboration and developing clear project roadmaps for complex, omni-channel campaigns.
Objective history of establishing operational efficiencies that reduced time-to-market or production costs.

Preferred Qualifications

Advanced program management skills with a track record of managing competing deliverables for both B2C and B2B SaaS environments.
Background in Agile methodologies or experience serving as a Scrum Master for creative sprints.
Strong analytical skills to assess operational bottlenecks and develop data-driven solutions.
Exceptional communication skills with the ability to influence senior leadership and translate technical requirements into creative briefs.
Familiarity with Digital Asset Management (DAM) implementation and creative production software.

Compensation

At Coursera, we offer competitive, zone-based pay aligned to your location, experience, and role level. Our total rewards package goes beyond salary, with comprehensive health and wellness benefits, bonus and RSU equity programs, and global perks designed to help you grow and thrive wherever you are.

Amazon Web Services is looking for a Infrastructure Technical Program Manager to support and deploy one of the world’s largest and most complex telecommunication networks. The role is responsible for the execution of a strategic plan to improve the business processes and deployment of hyper-scaled cloud infrastructure, creation of a quality control system for North and South America (NASA), pre/post-inspections for design validation, and piloting stakeholder communication for delivery schedules. This opportunity is within the Global Connectivity Infrastructure Delivery - Fiber Deployment organization, which is responsible for project management, quality and delivery of fiber capacity for the physical network solutions that drive Amazon’s internal infrastructure and connect our services to the world.

Program management skills to monitor vendor delivery of physical infrastructure projects. Technical skills of either fiber optic outside plant, process engineering, construction management or quality control systems is required.

Key Responsibilities Include

Reports to the NASA GCID-FD Deployment Manager, and updates regularly with the NASA and Global Senior management.
Serve as a key member of the North and South America GCID-FD team helping to drive overall Network Infrastructure strategy.

Develop a focused quality management program that tracks defects, mitigates risks, standardizes root cause analysis, and implements key performance measures to rate vendor success.
Create and standardize reporting mechanisms for the MFP&A group and provide regular progress updates on program deployment to management and stakeholders.
Periodically report on the overall network development program status across the assigned region.

Manage multiple competing cross-functional projects/programs simultaneously, some on a global scale.

This role oversees deployment of infrastructure, and iterative procedural changes. This includes travel to the field, generation of weekly reports, and updating standards and specifications for a global deployment team. This position requires onsite visits to physical locations and is not a full time remote job. Physical inspections and learning the technical standards for outside and inside fiber plant is required.

jobs.description:
Job Overview

Are you an experienced Project Manager with a strong background in construction, engineering, surveying or design? Are you looking for an opportunity to lead capital projects that directly contribute to the development of high-quality healthcare environments?

Working within a small, dedicated and collaborative team, you will have delegated responsibility for the successful delivery of individual capital schemes, from initial feasibility and design through to construction and completion. You will also take ownership of project budgets, ensuring schemes are delivered safely, efficiently, to the required quality standards and within agreed financial parameters.

Main duties of the job

You will lead a diverse portfolio of major and minor capital projects across the Trust estate and wider Frimley Health Integrated Care System (ICS). This is a varied role that will see you working closely with clinical and operational teams, Estates and Facilities colleagues, Capital Directors, Estates Managers and CAD Technicians, alongside external consultants, contractors and other key stakeholders.

Working for our organisation

Visa Sponsorship

This position is not eligible
for Skilled Worker visa sponsorship. Applicants must already hold the right to work in the UK
for the full duration of the contract.

Why Join Frimley Health NHS Foundation Trust?

At Frimley Health NHS Foundation Trust, our people are at the heart of everything we do.

As a Disability Confident Employer and recipient of the Gold Award in the Armed Forces Employer Recognition Scheme, we actively champion equality, diversity and inclusion, creating opportunities for people from all backgrounds to build rewarding careers within the NHS.

We also recognise the importance of a healthy work-life balance. By supporting flexible working arrangements wherever possible, we enable our colleagues to balance their professional and personal commitments while continuing to deliver outstanding care to our patients. Whether flexibility means adjusted hours, part-time working, hybrid arrangements or alternative working patterns, we work in partnership with our staff to meet both individual and service needs.

Join Us

Whether you're at the start of your career or looking for your next challenge, Frimley Health offers the opportunity to be part of a inclusive, forward-thinking organisation that is committed to excellence, innovation and compassionate care. Together, we can shape the future of healthcare and make a real difference to the lives of the communities we serve.

Frimley Health Trust benefits on Vimeo

Detailed Job Description And Main Responsibilities

Project and Design Management

Lead feasibility studies and design development for major and minor capital schemes, including the preparation of whole-scheme budget estimates.
Develop project briefs collaboratively with end users, ensuring requirements are clearly defined and formally approved.
Coordinate the development of detailed design information with members of the design team.
Lead the delivery of capital projects both on and off site, ensuring they progress effectively from inception to completion.
Monitor and manage project budgets, identifying and addressing financial risks at an early stage.
Provide professional and technical advice on capital projects and estate development as required.

Procurement and Contract Management

Identify and recommend appropriate procurement routes in accordance with Trust Standing Orders and Standing Financial Instructions (SFIs).
Prepare technical specifications and tender documentation for smaller capital schemes and manage the associated tender process.
Manage external design consultants and contractors, ensuring clear project requirements and formal briefings are established.
Administer scheme contracts, including the use of ProCure22 templates and proformas where appropriate.
Monitor contractor performance and ensure a high standard of workmanship throughout construction.

Stakeholder Engagement and Communication

Build effective working relationships with clinical, operational and Estates and Facilities colleagues, ensuring their requirements are understood and incorporated into project delivery.
Maintain clear and effective communication with internal and external stakeholders throughout the project lifecycle.
Provide regular progress updates on capital schemes, including formal reporting on a fortnightly basis or as required.
Work collaboratively with consultants, contractors, local authorities and other external organisations to support successful project delivery.

Information, Governance and Assurance

Maintain accurate and comprehensive electronic project records for all relevant schemes.
Ensure Trust CAD drawings and associated technical information are kept accurate and up to date.
Obtain and maintain accurate as-built and as-installed drawings for completed projects.
Ensure projects are delivered in accordance with relevant Trust policies, procedures, contractual requirements and governance arrangements.
Support the Associate Director, Hard FM, with delivery of the capital programme and contribute to the strategic planning and development of the Trust estate.
Work flexibly across the Frimley Health ICS patch as required.

Health and Safety

Ensure appropriate health and safety information, guidance and training is provided to staff, contractors and other site users within areas of responsibility.
Ensure construction and project activities are undertaken safely and in accordance with relevant legislation, Trust policies and procedures.
Take reasonable care of your own health and safety and that of others who may be affected by your work.

Corporate Responsibilities

Support the Trust's commitment to equality, diversity and inclusion and comply with relevant policies and procedures.
Maintain appropriate confidentiality and comply with Trust requirements relating to information governance and the Freedom of Information Act.
Undertake other duties appropriate to the level and responsibilities of the role, as required

We are looking for a proactive and solutions-focused professional with a 'can-do' attitude
, excellent project management skills and substantial experience of delivering complex capital schemes. You will be confident managing budgets, coordinating multidisciplinary teams and navigating projects from concept through to completion.

Frimley Health NHS Foundation Trust (FHFT) is proud of its strong reputation, record of achievement and ambition for the future. We serve a population of over 900,000 people across Berkshire, Hampshire, Surrey and South Buckinghamshire, and remain committed to improving the health and wellbeing of our communities.

Our new organisational strategy – FHFT 2030 – sets out our ambition to be the best place to receive care and the best place to work in the NHS. Underpinned by our Trust values – Committed to Excellence, Working Together, Facing the Future
, and being a modern, compassionate, Healthcare Organisation – we are creating a culture where our people can thrive and patients always come first.

We continue to invest heavily in our services and facilities. This includes the development of a new hospital at Frimley Park, major expansion of diagnostics and inpatient capacity, and the continued transformation of services across our sites. We have already delivered a brand-new £100m state-of-the-art Heatherwood Hospital, a £49m Emergency Assessment Centre at Wexham Park, and a £10m upgrade to maternity services.

We are also committed to sustainability and the NHS Net Zero ambition. Our new hospital and estate developments are being designed to be environmentally responsible, energy efficient, and future-proofed, featuring on-site renewables energy and intelligent energy systems. Through our green plan, we are embedding sustainable practices across all areas of care and operations, ensuring we reduce our environmental impact while improving population health and wellbeing. Alongside estates’ investments, we are embedding a strong focus on digital innovation and quality improvement. Our electronic patient record (Epic), launched in 2024, is already enabling safer, more connected, and more effective care for patients, while giving staff the tools they need to do their best work. Our electronic patient record also supports safe and effective digitised care pathways, savings time and carbon, whilst delivering excellent quality of care.

Everything we do is guided by our values, shaping how we care for patients, support colleagues, and build a sustainable future for healthcare together.

jobs.description:
Description

We are looking for a talented Senior Product Safety and Compliance Manager to help shape how product safety is managed across Africa, the Middle East, and Türkiye (AMET). You will own the regional product safety risk position, deciding how Amazon's safety policies apply to the specific risks and regulations of our region.

You will work with stakeholder teams including Selling Partner, Business, Legal, Customer Service, and Technology, and represent Amazon directly to regulatory authorities across the region. You will assess high-risk product categories, evaluate product test results, and apply the right mix of controls to reduce safety risk precisely, protecting customers while enabling the business to grow. You will bring together regional risk judgment, localization, and regulatory engagement to build and own the programs that make product safety work end to end across AMET stores.

Key job responsibilities

Own regional product safety risk and ensure regulatory requirements are met across Amazon's supply and customer operations in the AMET region.
Lead efforts to review and localize validation processes for newly onboarded, highly regulated products.
Collaborate with external regulatory authorities and design schemes to ensure product safety across AMET Amazon stores.
Drive resolution of product safety issues raised through customer complaints, customer reviews, internal follow-up actions, and product recall requests from external bodies.
Design, implement, and maintain product safety processes that interface with cross-functional teams and use classification and restriction databases.
Assess regional risk and apply proportionate risk-reduction measures for high-risk product categories.
Work effectively across functions and leverage available resources as the Amazon business grows.
Based in Dubai, UAE. Fluency in Arabic and English required.

A day in the life

Your main job is making sure the products customers buy from us across the region are safe and meet local rules. You will dig into product categories that carry higher risk, work through safety signals, and decide what needs to happen to protect customers without slowing the business down. You will do this with our selling partner, legal, business, and technology teams, and you will sit across the table from regulators, so being comfortable in both Arabic and English matters.

About The Team

Our team makes sure every product customers buy across Africa, the Middle East, and Türkiye is safe, meets local legal requirements, and lives up to what shoppers expect. We work shoulder to shoulder with retail, operations, legal, and technology partners, and we bring product and risk expertise together with regulatory insight to solve safety problems before they reach customers. Our mission is to support Amazon's goal of offering the widest possible selection while keeping unsafe and non-compliant products out of our stores. You will join a collaborative, fast-moving team that plays a highly visible role in protecting customers across the region.

Basic Qualifications

Bachelor's degree or equivalent
6+ years of program or project management experience
Experience managing multiple projects and priorities across teams in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment

Preferred Qualifications

5+ years of compliance program management, legal, governance, audit, risk/loss prevention, or equivalent experience
3+ years of program requirements definition and data and metrics leveraging to drive improvements experience
Professional auditing qualification, or similar risk or compliance credentials
Experience with SQL and Excel

jobs.description:
Position
: Program Manager, E6

Department
: E6 Outreach

Director

Case Managers

Monday- Friday, 8am- 4:30pm

Status:
Full-Time; Exempt (salary); Management

Benefits:
Medical, Dental, Vision, Retirement Planning (403b), Employee Assistance Program (EAP), etc.

SUMMARY:

Summary

As part of the LA County strategy to combat homelessness, the goal of E6 is to create a countywide network of multidisciplinary, integrated street-based teams to identify, engage, and connect, or re-connect homeless individuals to interim and/or permanent housing and supportive services.

The E6 Program Manager will provide leadership and oversight to area-specific multidisciplinary E6 Street Outreach teams. The Program Manager will ensure that appropriate, high quality, and integrated care and services are provided to clients, including carrying a case load themselves when necessary to support the team. The Program Manager is also responsible for efficiency of operations, coordinating services with partner agencies as needed, and fostering collaboration within the team between other departments and programs. The Program Manager is responsible for administrative aspects of team leadership, including data oversight and reporting of outcomes.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

Provide leadership to multidisciplinary teams, ensuring continuity of care and services between The People Concern agency resources and partnering public and private agencies.
Facilitate individual and team supervision utilizing a trauma-informed care lens and harm reduction approach.
Provide clinical guidance to staff as needed, including in psychiatric emergencies and crisis situations.
Provide assistance, in the field, in order to support the team or individual team members.
Be available to respond to emergency calls and situations on a 24-hour basis when needed.
As needed assist in the screening, assessment, enrollment, and case management of clients.
Ensure all paperwork and data collection is complete, timely, accurate, and current in agency records and electronic databases through on-going audits of electronic databases and chart reviews.
Ensure adherence to funding source contracts and performance standards; prepare written reports on program activities as assigned and as required by funding sources.
Provide training to staff on policies and procedures of the program and agency.
Hire and manage staffing of MDT team and ensure staff are adequately trained and abide by all agency and department policies and procedures.
Complete 90-day and annual performance evaluations in a timely manner.
Attend all department, agency-wide, and county/city service provider meetings and trainings (as necessary).

Qualifications

MSW, MFT, or LPCC who is registered with CA BBS (supervision hours are available for this position) OR five or more years’ experience working in outreach and with persons experiencing homelessness.
Two years’ experience providing direct supervision and management of staff; experience managing a team preferred.
Minimum of two years’ full-time experience working with individuals who are experiencing homelessness, preferably those living with mental illness and/or substance addictions and/or physical health challenges.
Detail oriented with excellent time management, organizational, written, verbal, interpersonal, and computer skills
Able to work in a high tolerance harm reduction model with individuals who have multiple barriers
Able to learn quickly and work effectively with a wide range of constituents
Strong interpersonal and team building skills
Self-starter with the ability to stay ahead of the curve and thrive in fast-paced work environment
Current, valid California Driver’s with an acceptable driving record
Able to obtain and maintain CPR/1st Aid certification
All internal candidates must be in good standing and in their current role for at least six months.

Work Environment

Combination of field and office environment
Regularly required to sit, stand, bend and occasionally lift or carry up to 35 pounds
On occasion drive to different sites throughout the assigned outreach area
Will necessitate working in busy and loud environments
Will be exposed to elements like cold, heat, dust, noise, odor, and smoke
May need to bend, stoop, twist, and sit throughout the day

EXPECTED BEHAVIORS OF ALL STAFF

Act as a role model
Demonstrate a sense of responsibility
Continuously learn and improve
Acknowledge your own areas of improvement
Hear and provide honest, specific and direct feedback
Create an environment where everyone is welcomed valued and respected
Collaborate

Equal Opportunity Employer

The People Concern is an equal opportunity employer dedicated to non-discrimination in employment. We select the most qualified individual for the job based on job-related qualifications regardless of race, color, age, sex, religion, national origin, disability, ancestry, marital status, credit history, sexual orientation, arrest and court record, genetic information, veteran status or any other status protected by federal, state or other applicable laws.  

About The People Concern

The People Concern empowers the most vulnerable among us to rebuild their lives. One of Los Angeles County’s largest social services agencies, The People Concern was formed in 2016 in a merger of two trusted social service organizations based in Los Angeles County, OPCC and Lamp Community. Informed by more than fifty-eight years of work in the community, The People Concern is a leading provider of, and advocate for, evidence-based solutions to the multi-faceted challenges inherent in homelessness and domestic violence.

With compassion and profound respect for those we serve, we provide a fully integrated system of care – including outreach, interim housing, mental and medical health care, substance abuse services, domestic violence services, life skills & wellness programs, and permanent supportive housing – tailored to the unique needs of homeless individuals, survivors of domestic violence, challenged youth, and others who have nowhere else to turn.

The People Concern’s model of integrated and comprehensive care empowers our participants to navigate the multi-faceted obstacles in their lives, become their best selves, and ultimately, connect with and contribute to their communities.

NTT DATA is seeking a Business Intelligence Analyst to support program operations, resource planning, decision support, and delivery enablement for a complex technology program. The analyst will convert operational, resource, financial, schedule, and delivery information into accurate reporting and practical recommendations that help leaders make informed decisions.

This is a hands-on individual contributor role for an analyst who can work across functions, independently address standard analytical needs, and apply structured analysis to ambiguous business problems. The role partners with program operations, PMO, finance, human resources, delivery leadership, and technical teams. The analyst will operate within established methods and priorities, seeking guidance for novel, sensitive, or higher-risk assignments.

Key Responsibilities

Business Intelligence and Decision Support

Collect, validate, organize, and analyze data from approved sources to support decisions related to resource deployment, staffing, scheduling, spend, delivery performance, and operational priorities.
Create and maintain recurring dashboards, reports, trackers, and executive summaries using approved tools and defined data sources.
Identify trends, variances, capacity concerns, data-quality issues, and operational dependencies; document assumptions and escalate material findings.

Respond to standard ad hoc data and reporting requests and publish results through well-developed business intelligence interfaces.

Operations and Resource Planning

Compare planned demand with available capacity and highlight potential overcapacity, undercapacity, timing conflicts, and skill gaps.
Partner with operations, finance, and human resources stakeholders to map workflows, clarify data ownership, and improve reporting consistency.

Maintain confidentiality when handling employee, commercial, client, or program-sensitive information.

Develop prototypes and low-code reporting solutions when appropriate, or coordinate with technical resources for more complex development.
Support user acceptance testing, data validation, documentation, training materials, and adoption of approved tools.
Map current-state workflows, identify inefficiencies or control gaps, and implement measurable process improvements with stakeholder support.
Maintain definitions, source-to-report traceability, version control, and operating instructions.

Identify suitable use cases, define requirements, test outputs, document limitations, and measure expected business value.

Apply human review, source validation, and appropriate escalation to reduce inaccurate, sensitive, or unsupported outputs.

Undergraduate degree in business analytics, business administration, information systems, data analytics, computer science, finance, operations, industrial engineering, or a related field, or comparable relevant experience consistent with company policy.

1+ years experience with data analysis and statistical concepts, including averages, distributions, trends, variance, and the relevance and limitations of information.

Ability to structure ambiguous problems, validate information, document assumptions, independently resolve standard analytical assignments.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, attention to detail, sound judgment, and commitment to confidentiality.
Ability to collaborate across business and technical teams in a fast-paced, multi-partner environment.
Ability to work effectively in a US Hybrid arrangement and participate in on-site activities based on business and client needs.

Experience gathering requirements, mapping processes, developing reports, or supporting user acceptance testing.

Using your Client and Project Management expertise, you will partner with our clients and internal teams to understand their goals, then develop project plans using industry standards and manage them through to completion. Naturally curious with an attention to detail, you’ll navigate issues as they arise and ensure they meet a resolution.

Day to day point person and Project Manager for launching new clients, communicating and collaborating throughout the implementation, and holding regularly scheduled calls with clients and internal teams to meet deadlines
Possess an understanding of client's business, program goals and objectives; implement varied use cases to ensure Movable Ink’s software drives measurable and scalable value
Build a strong rapport with new clients immediately; show expertise and earn trust to create a strong relationship

Lead and collaborate on custom, technical solutions for your clients, partnering closely with solutions developers, engineers, architects and product owners
Build excitement about their success with the service and do everything necessary to hit their goals/KPIs
Configure and thoroughly QA campaigns ahead of launches
Partner closely with sales and architects throughout the Implementation period to retain clients and upsell their accounts

Qualifications:

Direct experience working with enterprise mobile or email service providers (Attentive, Airship, Bird, Sinch, Vibes, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Oracle Responsys, Adobe Campaign, Adobe Journey Optimizer, Braze, Epsilon, Cordial, Cheetah Digital, Bloomreach, Zeta, Iterable)

jobs.title: Senior Program Manager, Creative Ops
jobs.description:
🚀 Join the Future of Commerce with Whatnot!

Whatnot is the largest live shopping platform in North America and Europe to buy, sell, and discover the things you love. Whether it's trading cards, fashion, electronics, or live plants, our sellers are building real businesses across hundreds of categories. We're building live commerce at a scale that's never been done in the West, and there's no playbook to copy. The people here are shaping how an entirely new industry develops.

As a remote co-located team, we're inspired by our values and anchored in hubs across the US, UK, Ireland, Poland, Germany, and Australia. We move fast, stay close to our users, and focus on the work that drives the most impact.

We're one of the fastest growing marketplaces and were recently named the #1 Best Startup Employer in America by Forbes. Check out the latest Whatnot updates on our news and engineering blogs and join us as we enable anyone to turn their passion into a business and bring people together through commerce.

💻 Role

We’re looking for a Senior Creative Operations Program Manager to lead large, high-visibility campaigns across the Whatnot brand. This person will sit at the center of Creative, Marketing, and Catex teams, bringing structure to complex initiatives, aligning stakeholders, and keeping work moving from kickoff through launch. You’ll manage multiple priorities at once, anticipate risks, and ensure the team has the clarity and resources needed to deliver great creative work.

What You’ll Own

Campaign program leadership. Lead multiple complex, high-visibility campaigns from kickoff through launch. Build clear project plans that align stakeholders around scope, milestones, owners, approvals, dependencies, and deliverables.
Prioritization and resourcing. Partner with creative leadership to evaluate incoming requests, sequence work, and focus the team on the highest-impact priorities. Maintain a clear view of capacity and flag when timelines, scope, or resources need to shift.
Cross-functional alignment and decision-making. Bring Creative, Marketing, and partner teams together around shared goals and clear expectations. Lead working sessions and reviews that drive timely decisions, establish ownership, and keep work moving.
Communication and relationship building. Build trust through clear, thoughtful communication tailored to different audiences. Navigate complex interpersonal dynamics with empathy and confidence while contributing to a collaborative, solutions-oriented team culture.
Risk and dependency management. Anticipate challenges, identify critical dependencies, and surface tradeoffs early. Resolve blockers before they put timelines, budgets, or creative quality at risk.
Creative operations and ways of working. Build and refine practical workflows that make it easier for the team to collaborate and deliver great work. Introduce the right amount of structure without creating unnecessary process or slowing the team down.
Program visibility and measurement. Create a clear view of what’s in flight, what’s at risk, and where decisions are needed. Define success, track progress and outcomes, and apply learnings to make future programs stronger.

We offer flexibility to work from home or from one of our global office hubs, and we value in-person time for planning, problem-solving, and connection. Team members in this role must live within commuting distance of our San Francisco, Seattle, Los Angeles, and New York City hubs.

👋 You

People who do well at Whatnot tend to be comfortable figuring things out as they go, biased toward action, and genuinely curious about what they’re building. They care more about outcomes than credit and stay close to the product and the people using it.

For This Role Specifically, You Should Have

6+ years of experience in creative, marketing, or design program management, ideally at a high-growth consumer company, marketplace, or creator-focused platform. You’ve worked closely with Creative, Marketing, and GTM teams from early planning through final delivery.
A track record of leading complex, integrated campaigns. You’ve successfully managed large-scale brand initiatives with multiple workstreams, stakeholders, deliverables, and dependencies, bringing structure to the work without slowing it down.
Strong creative production fluency. You understand how creative work moves from brief and concept through reviews, production, and launch. You know what teams need to do their best work and can build realistic timelines around the creative process.
Exceptional prioritization and project management instincts. You can separate urgent from important, assess tradeoffs, and translate shifting priorities into a clear plan. You’re highly organized, detail-oriented, and able to keep several initiatives moving at once.
Clear communication and strong relationship-building skills. You can turn messy information, competing opinions, and complex blockers into clear recommendations.
Comfort with ambiguity and ownership. You operate independently, identify what needs to happen next, and move work forward without waiting for perfect direction. When a problem arises, you bring practical solutions—not just the problem.
Operational and analytical judgment. You use data to identify issues, measure progress, and improve how teams work. You’re comfortable managing vendors and contractors and adapting project management, resourcing, and reporting tools to fit the team’s needs.

🎁 Benefits

Generous Holiday and Time off Policy
Health Insurance options including Medical, Dental, Vision
Work From Home Support
Home office setup allowance
Monthly allowance for cell phone and internet

Care benefits
Monthly allowance for wellness
Annual allowance towards Childcare
Lifetime benefit for family planning, such as adoption or fertility expenses

Retirement; 401k offering for Traditional and Roth accounts in the US (employer match up to 4% of base salary) and Pension plans internationally
Monthly allowance to dogfood the app
All Whatnauts are expected to develop a deep understanding of our product. We're passionate about building the best user experience, and all employees are expected to use Whatnot as both a buyer and a seller as part of their job (our dogfooding budget makes this fun and easy!).

Parental Leave
16 weeks of paid parental leave + one month gradual return to work *company leave allowances run concurrently with country leave requirements which take precedence.

Enjoy a true sense of ownership as you work with a proven industry leader on some of the most exciting and high-profile projects in the nation. We offer a wide range of job opportunities, competitive compensation, full benefits, an Employee Stock Ownership Plan and more.

Why Rosendin?

Committed. Connected. Engaged.

If you’re looking to take your career to the next level and work with some of the best and brightest in the industry, we want to hear from you. We are an organization built on integrity. We have a culture that empowers people, embraces diversity and inspires everyone to do their best. Rosendin is the largest EMPLOYEE-OWNED electrical contractor in the United States employing upwards of 8,000 people. Established in 1919, we remain proud of our more than 100 years of building quality electrical and communications installations and value for our clients but, most importantly, for building people within our company and our communities. As an employee-owner you will have the unique benefit of being a shareholder at a company that is experiencing tremendous growth and success which means you benefit tremendously.

Your Next Opportunity

Take the lead in driving success for Low Voltage projects
that power connectivity and security for our clients. As a Senior Project Manager, you will oversee the overall direction, completion, and financial performance of multiple small-to-medium projects or one large-scale initiative. You’ll manage and mentor a team of Project Managers and Assistant Project Managers, ensuring projects are delivered on time, within budget, and to the highest quality standards.

What You'll Do

Lead projects involving structured cabling, security systems, access control, audio/visual, and network infrastructure.
Establish project objectives, policies, procedures and performance standards within boundaries of corporate policies. Put these in clear concise work statement for the field.
Effectively supervise a staff in the day to day administration of a job or supervise two or more Project Managers in their daily tasks.
Train and effectively supervise Project Managers in the company philosophy and systems
Negotiate and supervise the preparation of all change orders on the project
Maintain all logs required to track the progress of the project.
Train and effectively supervise a Project Assistant in the maintenance of project required tracking devices.
Maintain liaison with prime client and A/E to facilitate construction activities.
Monitor construction activities in conjunction with the onsite Foreman and Area Superintendent to ensure project is being built on schedule, and within budgets
Investigate any potentially serious situations and implement corrective measures within company guidelines, and under supervision
Represent company/project in meetings with client, subcontractors, etc.
Prepare monthly costing reports
Manage financial aspects of contracts (progress billing, rental equipment, income/expenses) to protect the company’s interest and simultaneously maintain good relationship with the client
The duties and responsibilities are intended to describe the general nature and scope of work being performed by this position. This is not a complete listing and other duties will be assigned based on the role within the business unit.

What You'll Need To Be Successful

Project accountability and initiative for all aspects of the project and its success.
Ability to creatively solve problems. You’ve been in the trenches before. You know what it takes to get the job done and done right for your customer and the company.
A strong knowledge of electrical systems, construction, and how these systems work.
A fanatical determination about planning, innovating, and improving the processes we use every day.
Ability to think outside the box and lead the team in driving innovative construction techniques and prefabrication strategies.
Possess strong leadership skills, business acumen, and integrity.
A strong understanding of the financials of a project and how to forecast.
Ability to create and foster great relationships with the field and understand what it takes to get the best out of your people.
Ability to work collaboratively with multiple stakeholders to achieve mutual outcomes.
We are counting on you to bring and foster a collaborative spirit to our work process.

What You Bring To Us

Bachelor’s degree in Construction Management, Civil Engineering, Structural Engineering or other related discipline preferred.
PE license a plus
Minimum 10+ years of experience in project management, preferably in electrical construction. Knowledge of construction technology, scheduling, equipment and methods required.
Can be a combination of education, training and relevant experience
Proven experience mentoring and managing others.
Business development/heavy client interaction a plus.
Ability to understand and follow standard operating policies and procedures;
Ability to perform duties in a professional manner and appearance
Extensive knowledge of safety protocols and procedure
Proficient in using a computer and Microsoft Office (Outlook, Word, Excel, etc.); Oracle and Accubid preferred
Ability to prioritize and manage multiple tasks, changing priorities as necessary
Ability to work under time pressure and adapt to changing requirements with a positive attitude
Effective oral and written communication skills as required for the position
Ability to be self-motivated, proactive and an effective team player
Ability to interact effectively and professionally with all levels of employees, both management and staff alike, vendors, clients, and others

Travel

10-25%

Working Conditions

General work environment – Due to the variety of work to be performed, the Sr. Project Manager may be working at a job site or in the office. This position is performed primarily on active construction sites. Activity includes sitting for extended periods, standing, walking, typing, carrying, pushing, bending. Work is conducted primarily indoors with varying environmental conditions, such as fluorescent lighting and air conditioning.
Noise level is usually low to medium; can be loud on a job site.
Occasional lifting of up to 30 lbs.
We fully comply with the ADA and applicable state law, including considering reasonable accommodation measures that may enable qualified disabled applicants and employees to perform essential functions.

YOU Matter – Our Benefits

ESOP – Employee Stock Ownership
401k
Annual bonus program based upon performance, profitability, and achievement
17 PTO days per year plus 10 paid holidays
Medical, Dental, Vision Insurance
Term Life, AD&D Insurance, and Voluntary Life Insurance
Disability Income Protection Insurance
Pre-tax Flexible Spending Plans (Health and Dependent Care)
Charitable Giving Match with our Rosendin Foundation

Pay Range

$168,400.00-$221,000.00 Annual

to join our growing team.
This role is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-paced digital environment, enjoys bringing structure to complex workflows and knows how to keep multiple projects, people and deadlines moving at the same time.

, following up with team members, solving problems and escalating risks before they become issues.

Please note:
We are looking for candidates with web development project management experience
— this is a priority for the role. Experience in a digital marketing agency
is also highly preferred.

Manage multiple projects simultaneously from planning through to completion.
Develop clear project timelines, milestones, priorities and deliverables.
Coordinate work across different teams, including design, development, marketing, content and other operational functions.
Assign and monitor tasks and ensure team members understand their responsibilities and deadlines.
Conduct regular project follow-ups and ensure outstanding tasks continue moving forward.
Identify bottlenecks, dependencies and potential delays early and take action to resolve them.

Ensure completed work meets project requirements before projects are considered complete.

Strong experience working with cross-functional teams.
Excellent organisational and time-management skills.
Strong attention to detail and ability to maintain accurate project records.
Excellent written and spoken English.
Strong communication skills and confidence following up with team members and stakeholders.

.

.
Experience managing website, digital marketing, SEO, paid advertising, design or development projects.

.
Experience managing remote or internationally distributed teams.
Experience developing processes, workflows and SOPs.
Project management qualifications such as PMP, PRINCE2, Agile or Scrum certification
.

Projects are delivered on time and important deadlines are rarely missed.
Management has clear visibility over the status of every project.
Team members know exactly what they are responsible for and when it is due.
Delays and bottlenecks are identified before they become major problems.

You actively drive projects forward rather than waiting for others to provide updates.
Processes become more organised and efficient as a result of your involvement.

You don't need to be reminded to follow something up. If a deadline is approaching, you already know about it and are working with the relevant person to make sure it is delivered.

jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.description:
About Us

We are the independent expert in assurance and risk management. Driven by our purpose, to safeguard life, property, and the environment, we empower our customers and their stakeholders with facts and reliable insights so that critical decisions can be made with confidence.

As a trusted voice for many of the world’s most successful organizations, we use our knowledge to advance safety and performance, set industry benchmarks, and inspire and invent solutions to tackle global transformations.

About Energy Systems

We help customers navigate the complex transition to a decarbonized and more sustainable energy future. We do this by assuring that energy systems work safely and effectively, using solutions that are increasingly digital. We also help industries and governments to navigate the many complex, interrelated transitions taking place globally and regionally, in the energy industry.

About The Role

Are you passionate about renewable energy and ready to make a tangible impact? Do you thrive on managing end-to-end projects and customer relationships? Are you excited to join a dynamic and collaborative team that is shaping the future of sustainable power? If so, apply now for the Project Manager role at GreenPowerMonitor (GPM). Together, we can create a greener tomorrow!

You will drive planning, execution, and delivery of key projects focused on implementing GPM data-driven digital solutions (SCADA &PPC) for the control, monitoring, and asset management of renewable energy sites, including photovoltaic, wind, and battery storage. You will collaborate closely with our customers and internal teams to ensure successful project outcomes.

Your Key Responsibilities

Oversee end-to-end project management, from the receipt of the Purchase Order to the successful delivery and final acceptance by the customer
Define project requirements to ensure alignment with customer needs and develop detailed project plans, including milestones, timelines, resource allocation, and risk management
Supervise and delegate project tasks across Project Engineers and cross-functional teams (logistics, purchasing, IT, GI,…) ensuring efficient task distribution and execution
Oversee purchasing and supplier assignments, ensuring timely procurement of materials and services required for project success
Ensure projects are delivered on time, within scope, and within budget while meeting customer requirements and quality standards
Act as the primary point of contact for clients, managing relationships and expectations throughout the project lifecycle
Write technical reports and communicate progress, challenges, and solutions to stakeholders, both internally and externally on a regular basis
Continuously drive process improvements and best practices in project management

The team awaiting you…

You will join our Project Execution team in the On-site Solutions area. Our commitment is to successfully deliver On-site Solutions (SCADA and PPC) projects, while ensuring adherence to scope, schedule, and budget constraints. This involves a comprehensive approach that not only prioritizes excellence but also emphasizes efficiency and performance to provide the optimum experience and highest quality to our customers. To achieve this, we actively create specific tools and automation processes, enabling us to deliver intelligently and uphold our position as industry leaders.

GreenPowerMonitor, a DNV company, is at the heart of the global energy transformation. We use data-driven digital solutions to optimise the performance of renewable energy installations around the world. Our work contributes to a more diverse, more sustainable global energy mix.

What we offer

Wellbeing: DNV understands the importance of physical and mental wellbeing and aligned with our value of caring for our people, we have a ‘Be Well’ program in place.
Bonus opportunity: We believe it is important to reward our employees with an annual discretionary profit scheme or sales incentive scheme – depending on your role.
Insurances: DNV covers permanent employees for life and total permanent disability insurance as well as salary continuance insurance to safeguard you within our DNV Superannuation scheme.
Parental and long service leave: DNV has a generous parental leave and long service leave policy.
Hybrid work: We offer a hybrid work model to foster our culture while providing you with working flexibility.
Professional membership: We will support you with membership fees for your relevant governing body applicable to your position.
Social activities: To foster our culture, we enjoy regular social get togethers. DNV is an Equal Opportunity Employer and gives consideration for employment to qualified applicants without regard to gender, religion, race, national or ethnic origin, cultural background, social group, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, age or political opinion. Diversity is fundamental to our culture and we invite you to be part of this diversity.

About You

To thrive and succeed, we expect you to have:

Minimum a bachelor´s degree in engineering.
4-5 years of experience in project management in the renewable energy industry (photovoltaic, wind, and/or battery storage domains).
Experience with monitoring and control systems such as SCADA.
A proven track record of driving commercial & industrial (C&I) and/or utility-scale projects to successful completion on time and within budget.
Excellent organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and stakeholders and deliver high-quality work.
Customer-oriented mindset with a commitment to understanding and addressing client needs.
Fluency in written and spoken English

It Would Be a Plus To Have

Certifications in project management
Knowledge of industrial communication protocols such as Modbus, IEC 60870‑5‑104 (IEC104), IEC 61850, DNP3, or similar.

Security and compliance with statutory requirements in the countries in which we operate is essential for DNV. Background checks will be conducted on all final candidates as part of the offer process, in accordance with applicable country-specific laws and practices.

jobs.title: Senior Technical Program Manager, Quantum Computing Applied Research
jobs.description:
NVIDIA has been transforming computer graphics, PC gaming, and accelerated computing for more than 25 years. It’s a unique legacy of innovation that’s motivated by great technology—and amazing people. Today, we’re tapping into the unlimited potential of AI to define the next era of computing. An era in which our GPU acts as the brains of computers, robots, and self-driving cars that can understand the world. Doing what’s never been done before takes vision, innovation, and the world’s best talent. As an NVIDIAN, you’ll be immersed in a diverse, supportive environment where everyone is inspired to do their best work. Join our team and discover how you can develop a lasting impact on the world.

Quantum computing is accelerating from lab to utility, and NVIDIA sits at the center of that shift. We are seeking a Senior Technical Program Manager to lead high-impact strategic R&D initiatives within quantum computing. You will lead across our applied research R&D roadmap to craft clarity and success. We are innovating groundbreaking techniques for quantum in AI and accelerated computing, so that useful fault-tolerant quantum computing arrives sooner. Partner across engineering, applied research, and product teams inside NVIDIA, and with external collaborators, you will build and operationalize innovation roadmaps that pioneer ahead. Success in this role includes outstanding program leadership, communication, and problem solving. If you're passionate about bringing quantum computing into the fault-tolerant era with accelerated computing, we would love to hear from you!

What You'll Be Doing

Initiate and lead multiple concurrent technical programs across our quantum computing portfolio, with emphasis on bringing the full power of accelerated computing to the field.
Define clear execution plans and measurable outcomes from our R&D and technology roadmaps, then lown the work to success across teams.
Identify & prioritize the most critical activities required for the research's success, and ensure that they are completed.
Develop a strong technical understanding of our R&D priorities, to enable successful collaborations, and proactively identify new opportunities.
Creatively solve and mitigate technical challenges, while establishing early risk identification and mitigations.
Serve as a link between research and engineering, moving new technologies from incubation to scalable solutions.

What We Need To See

Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in Computer Science, Engineering, Physics, Applied Mathematics, or a related technical field.
10+ years of technical program management experience leading large-scale, cross-functional technology initiatives, including multiple sophisticated programs at once and execution alongside research, engineering, and technical leadership.
Validated understanding of the quantum computing ecosystem and technologies, including hardware and software.
Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to translate sophisticated technical concepts for a range of audiences.

Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd

Advanced degree (MS or PhD or equivalent) in quantum information science, physics, or a closely related field, or hands-on research or engineering experience inside a quantum program.
Background in translating research output to developed technology.
Familiarity with GPU-accelerated computing, HPC environments, or hybrid quantum-classical workflows and the tooling around them.
Experience running joint technical programs with national laboratories, companies, universities, or research institutions.

Widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers, NVIDIA offers highly competitive salaries and a comprehensive benefits package. As you plan your future, see what we can offer to you and your family www.nvidiabenefits.com/

jobs.description:
Job Duties/Scope Of Work

WORK SAFE, MAKE A DIFFERENCE, AND BE A PART OF HISTORY WITH THE CPCCo TEAM!

At Central Plateau Cleanup Company (CPCCo), located in Richland, Washington, we are working to provide a sustainable future for the historic Hanford Site through protection of the Columbia River and remediation of the Central Plateau. To achieve our mission, we need exceptionally talented, innovative, and driven people to help reduce environmental risk and advance cleanup of one of the nation's most complex environmental remediation sites.

CPCCo Soil and Groundwater Operations is seeking a Program Manager – TPA Management to support the Regulatory Strategy and Integration (RSI) organization. This position will report to the Strategic Planning and Business Services Manager and will lead the integration and coordination of activities associated with the Hanford Federal Facility Agreement and Consent Order (Tri-Party Agreement or TPA), with an emphasis on developing, negotiating, managing, and implementing milestones that support Hanford cleanup priorities. The successful candidate will serve as a key integrator among RSI, CPCCo project organizations, the U.S. Department of Energy (DOE), the U.S. Environmental Protection Agency (EPA), Washington State Department of Ecology, and other Hanford Site contractors. The position requires the ability to understand complex regulatory and technical issues, identify cross-program dependencies, facilitate development of integrated strategies, and help move diverse organizations toward executable and mutually understood cleanup commitments.

Primary duties of a Program Manager - TPA Management include, but are not limited to:

Lead CPCCo integration and coordination associated with the development, negotiation, modification, implementation, tracking, and completion of TPA milestones and associated regulatory commitments.
Coordinate with DOE and regulatory stakeholders to develop milestone strategies that advance Hanford cleanup while considering regulatory requirements, project sequencing, field implementation, and overall mission priorities.
Support and facilitate negotiations with DOE, EPA, and Washington State Department of Ecology involving new or modified TPA milestones, schedules, commitments, and cleanup strategies.
Provide programmatic leadership for implementation of TPA milestone strategies, including adaptive milestone approaches that allow cleanup priorities and implementation sequencing to evolve as additional technical information and field conditions become available.
Coordinate closely with control account managers (CAM's), scientists, modelers, technical writers, and management to ensure proposed regulatory commitments are technically supported and can be translated into executable scope.
Work across CPCCo organizations to integrate regulatory commitments with project planning, field execution, schedules, contract requirements, and performance commitments.
Coordinate with other Hanford Site contractors when milestone commitments, cleanup sequencing, infrastructure, or other project dependencies cross contractor boundaries.
Maintain an integrated understanding of TPA milestones and associated dependencies across CPCCo scope and communicate emerging issues, decisions, and risks to senior management.
Support alignment of TPA commitments with DOE priorities, CPCCo task-order planning, and long-range cleanup strategies.
Develop and maintain productive working relationships with DOE, EPA, Ecology, CPCCo organizations, and other Hanford contractors to promote collaborative resolution of issues and successful execution of cleanup commitments.
Provide strategic recommendations to CPCCo management regarding milestone development, sequencing, regulatory strategy, and opportunities to improve integration and execution of cleanup scope.

Basic Qualifications

Career Grade 20: Bachelor's degree or equivalent combination of education and experience plus 8 or more years of relevant experience.
Senior Grade 21: Bachelor's degree or equivalent combination of education and experience plus 10 or more years of relevant experience.

The higher posted level has greater scope, complexity, authority, impact. The level offered to the selected candidate will be based on the needs of the company and the candidate's education, training, and/or experience.

Desired Qualifications

Demonstrated knowledge of the Hanford Federal Facility Agreement and Consent Order (Tri-Party Agreement) and its role in establishing and managing Hanford cleanup commitments.
Experience working with DOE, EPA, Washington State Department of Ecology, or similar federal and state regulatory organizations.
Knowledge of CERCLA and RCRA regulatory processes and their application to environmental remediation and cleanup decision-making.
Experience integrating complex scope across multiple projects, programs, contractors, or stakeholder organizations.

Compensation & Benefits

In accordance with the CPCCo salary determination process, CPCCo takes into consideration the level of assigned job duties and responsibilities, and the candidate's education, training, and/or experience relative to internal peers and the external labor market. CPCCo will not solicit salary history for candidates.

Career Level Grade 20: $114,700 - $183,450
Senior Level Grade 21: $126,200 - $202,000

In addition to base pay, employees may be eligible for variable pay awards.

CPCCo's generous benefits package offers medical/dental/vision insurance, life insurance, 401(k) employer match and paid time off. For a full list of benefits please see https://cpcco.hanford.gov/page.cfm/Careers

A casual-dress work environment, where jeans are a regular thing.
A standard 4-10's work schedule that allows for long weekends and recharging on the Columbia River, on a golf course, at 200+ surrounding wineries, or at other Pacific Northwest destinations where fishing, hunting, snowboarding, hiking, and other outdoor sporting opportunities are in abundance.
