jobs.description:
NVIDIA's deep learning platforms are at the forefront of innovation, profoundly impacting various fields and widely adopted by leading academic institutions, startups, and major Internet companies globally. We're seeking an accomplished and highly skilled Technical Program Manager (TPM) to join our NVIDIA DGX Cloud team. This is an exciting opportunity for a passionate, focused, and creative individual to provide outstanding value to our DGX Cloud customers. We are specifically looking for a TPM with extensive background in cloud infrastructure bring-up with external partners. You will play a key role in collaborating with CSPs, emerging cloud providers and engineering teams internally to help build AI capacity and infrastructure across the globe!

What You'll Be Doing

As a DGX Cloud Technical Program Manager, you'll be a key partner to our Engineering, Infrastructure, Software teams and their leadership, driving critical programs related to AI capacity enablement and management. You'll play a pivotal role in developing and maturing foundational capabilities and processes for DGX Cloud, spanning critical areas such as cluster/capacity bring-up including CPU, storage, networking and compute requirements to support GPUs. This is a dynamic, fast-paced environment where TPMs are encouraged to apply fungible abilities to a range of high-impact programs within the DGX Cloud ecosystem.

Your Responsibilities Will Include

Working in close coordination with storage engineering and network engineering teams to define and communicate requirements to CSP (Cloud Service Providers) and NCP’s (NVIDIA Cloud Providers). Drive alignment and a POR for capacity blocks based on workload needs.
Drive early engagement with CSP (Cloud Service Providers) and NCP’s (NVIDIA Cloud Providers) to understand their managed storage, network solutions and influence alignment with NVIDIA Cloud roadmap
Gathering technical requirements, developing comprehensive roadmaps, establishing clear turning points, and ensuring adherence to our Product Lifecycle (PLC) process.
Managing ongoing capacity operations and the engineering engagement with CSP (Cloud Service Providers) and NCP’s (NVIDIA Cloud Provider) partners, collaborating closely with engineering leads. Focus on availability, maintenance and other critical performance indicators.
Partner closely within NVIDIA to understand workload requirements and related hardware and infrastructure needs. This includes speeds and feeds to optimize infrastructure readiness with cloud vendors and NVIDIA Cloud Providers.
Demonstrating Jira and other program management platforms to instill rigor and structure in the management of engineering deliverables.
Identifying and driving opportunities to onboard the adoption of third-party and in-house cloud infrastructure solutions for deployments, support, security, compliance and observability across DGX Cloud
Establishing key performance indicators (KPIs) and quantitatively demonstrating the value and impact delivered by your programs.
Proactively identifying, resolving, and mitigating risks and issues that could affect scope, schedule, and quality across all program aspects.
Encouraging a culture of continuous improvement, consistently seeing opportunities for process improvements within our cloud infrastructure operations.

What We Need To See

10+ years of technical program management experience. You have driven the planning and execution of large-scale cloud infrastructure programs with outside organizations. You focus strongly on software engineering projects within a matrixed organization.
Extensive hands-on experience in cloud infrastructure, preferably gained from working at a major Cloud Service Provider (CSP).
Domain knowledge in the bring-up and end to end operations of compute, storage and GPU (including common failure points at the HW and SW levels).
Expert-level proficiency with Jira, Smartsheet, or similar program management tools, with the ability to expertly guide engineering teams on their use of the tools.
Outstanding strategic and tactical thinking abilities, coupled with a strong capacity to build consensus and drive program success
Comfort and efficiency in growing within ambiguous environments.
Possess excellent communication and technical presentation skills, particularly for executive audiences.
BS or MS in Electrical Engineering or Computer Science, or equivalent experience.

Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd

In depth knowledge of NVIDIA GPU products, including deployment and bring-up
Working knowledge of various cloud technologies (Kubernetes, API integration, Terraform, etc)
A highly enthusiastic, lively, responsive, and passionate individual who actively notices and addresses process improvement opportunities.
Significant experience with productivity tools and process automation is a major plus.
Deep familiarity with cloud-native product / services environments and familiarity with AI, ML infrastructure, and cloud/services

jobs.description:
Req Id:
430447

Connection is everything. It drives us to innovate, explore, and stay close to what matters to us most. At Bell, we’re building a more connected future through world-class networks, AI-powered solutions, and digital experiences that elevate how people live, work, and play every day.

We believe in empowering people. That’s why we equip our teams with cutting-edge technology, AI tools, and a collaborative environment that supports creativity and growth. Want to be part of a diverse team where your work makes a real impact? If you’re inspired by innovation that advances how people connect and transforms what’s possible, you belong on #TeamBell.

Summary

We are seeking a Security Operations Analyst II to join Bell’s Security Operations team, playing a critical role in protecting and supporting one of Canada’s largest telecommunications networks. This is a Level 3 (L3) security operations role responsible for leading the investigation, analysis, and resolution of complex security incidents, advanced threats, and escalated cybersecurity events across enterprise and customer environments. The successful candidate will possess strong hands-on experience with Palo Alto Networks security solutions and Cisco Identity Services Engine (ISE), leveraging these technologies to support threat detection, access control, incident response, and security monitoring activities. Working closely with internal teams and customers, you will provide senior-level technical expertise, drive incident remediation efforts, ensure compliance with contractual security requirements, and contribute to the continuous enhancement of security operations capabilities. This position requires deep knowledge of cybersecurity operations, security technologies, and forensic investigation practices, along with the ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced 24/7 environment while serving as a key contributor or lead within the Security Incident Response Team (SIRT).

Key Responsibilities

Manage the daily customer requests for changes to their security infrastructure.
Prepare changes for security devices such as firewalls, intrusion detection and prevention systems, identity access management, etc.
Participate in new client onboarding projects and services and prepare implementations.
Review and interpret security alerts and provide diagnostics in the management of incidents to support clients.
Depending on the nature of the security threat, assess and develop mitigation measures to ensure that appropriate treatment is applied, and customers are informed.
Take proactive measures to manage all perimeter security equipment or associated components that may be interrupted or affected due to threats or vulnerabilities.
Configure, install, manage, and maintain security devices and provide general information and recommendations on security best practices.
Develop documentation associated with maintenance releases and keep it updated.
Observe security management best practices.

Critical Qualifications

Completion of a University or College program in Computer Science; or 5 years of equivalent industry experience in the information systems field.
Demonstrated experience in the design, implementation, and troubleshooting of security solutions including authentication, authorization, encryption, and audit capabilities as part of an overall system design.
Recognized hands-on experience in the implementation, daily management, and troubleshooting of firewalls from multiple vendors.
Hands-on experience in maintaining and deploying SDWAN solutions.
Proven experience in the daily management and troubleshooting of intrusion detection and prevention systems (IPS).
Experience in troubleshooting security solutions including authentication capabilities, authorization, and encryption, as well as securing devices access.
Experience in translating complex and ambiguous problems into actionable items.
Ability to work with multiple clients and across multiple technologies.
Ability to work under pressure (required during incidents).
Good communication, writing, and presentation skills. Autonomous, with excellent organizational and interpersonal skills.
Excellent communication skills in French and English (written and spoken).

Preferred Qualifications

Hands-on security certifications from major vendors.
Experience working with the following security vendors: Palo Alto, Juniper, Cisco, Fortinet, Arcsight, Checkpoint, etc.
Knowledge of offensive and defensive security operational tactics.
Understanding of compliance frameworks such as NIST, ISO 27001, ITIL, SAS70 (or 5970) and/or others.
Knowledge of security information and event management (SIEM).

Adequate knowledge of French is required for positions in Quebec.

jobs.title: Cybersecurity Business Analyst — Data Risk – Multiple Offices (Hybrid)
jobs.description:
The Cybersecurity Business Analyst - Data Risk, is responsible for identifying, analyzing, and helping remediate risks to the firm's sensitive and regulated data throughout its lifecycle. The role bridges security, privacy, compliance, and business teams—translating data protection requirements into actionable controls, clear reporting, and prioritized risk decisions that reduce exposure while enabling the business.

This is a hybrid position and can be resident in Phoenix, AZ; Atlanta, GA; Minneapolis, MN; Seattle, WA; Charlotte, NC; Miami or Orlando, FL; or Dallas, TX, with an onsite expectation of once per month.

Pursuant to Washington and Minneapolis regulations, the salary range is $137,800 to $151,600 annually and includes eligibility for performance-based bonuses. Factors which may affect starting pay within this range may include geography/market, skills, education, experience and other qualifications of the successful candidate. We offer generous compensation and benefits packages. For more information visit: https://www.littler.com/benefits/state-details.

Responsibilities

Data risk analysis and assessment

Maintain an inventory of sensitive and regulated data, data flows, systems, and third-party sharing.
Conduct data risk assessments covering confidentiality, integrity, availability, and regulatory exposure.
Analyze data classification, access, retention, and handling to identify gaps and control weaknesses.
Quantify and prioritize data risks, and track remediation activities through to closure.

Data governance and controls

Support data classification, DLP, and data protection policies and standards.
Translate privacy and regulatory requirements (e.g., GDPR, CCPA, HIPAA where applicable) into data control requirements.
Partner with control owners to define, document, and validate data safeguards.
Monitor control effectiveness and produce metrics on the firm’s data risk posture.

Requirements, reporting, and analysis

Gather and document business and security requirements for data protection initiatives.
Build dashboards and reports on data risk, exposure, and remediation progress for leadership.
Perform root-cause and trend analysis on data incidents, DLP alerts, and access anomalies.
Support audits and client assessments with data risk evidence and documentation.

Stakeholder enablement and collaboration

Serve as a liaison between Security, Privacy, Risk, IT, and business stakeholders.
Translate technical data risks into clear business language and actionable recommendations.
Provide guidance that helps teams handle data safely and meet compliance obligations.
Support response to data-related incidents, findings, and control failures.

Qualifications

Preferred qualifications

Experience in a legal, professional services, or other highly regulated environment.
Familiarity with data governance and risk platforms (e.g., OneTrust, Microsoft Purview, ServiceNow).
Comfort with data analysis and visualization tools (e.g., Excel / Power BI) and basic querying (e.g., SQL).

Certifications

Core security / risk: CISM, CRISC, or CISSP.
Data / privacy: CIPP, CIPM, or CDPSE.
Governance / analysis: ISO/IEC 27001 lead implementer/auditor or a recognized business analysis certification (e.g., CBAP).

About Littler

Littler is the largest global employment and labor law practice in the world exclusively devoted to representing management. With more than 1,900 attorneys in over 100 offices worldwide, Littler serves as the single source solution provider to the global employer community. Consistently recognized in the industry as a leading and innovative law practice, Littler has been litigating, mediating and negotiating some of the most influential employment law cases and labor contracts on record for over 75 years.

Littler’s unparalleled commitment to labor and employment law helps clients navigate a complex business world with nuanced legal issues—building better solutions for clients’ toughest challenges. With deep experience and resources that are local, everywhere, Littler is fully focused on its clients. With a diverse team of the brightest minds, Littler fosters a culture that celebrates original thinking. And with powerful proprietary technology, Littler disrupts the status quo—delivering bold, groundbreaking innovation that prepares employers not just for what’s happening today, but for what’s likely to happen tomorrow.

Benefits

We offer a generous benefits package to full-time and part-time employees working at least a 50% schedule. Benefits include comprehensive health, dental and vision plan for you, your spouse/domestic partner and children. In addition, we provide a superior 401(k) plan, ample time off programs, mental health programs, family building and caregiving, generous paid parental leave, life insurance, disability insurance, a wellness program, flexible spending accounts, and an employee referral bonus program.

For more information about our benefits visit: www.littler.com/benefits/state-details.

For more information about our firm visit: www.littler.com.

No recruiters –principals only. Littler is not accepting unsolicited resumes from search firms for this position. Search firms who submit candidates for this position are not eligible for any form of compensation, even if the candidate is successfully hired.

Please note applications are only accepted through our careers page www.littler.com/careers. For inquiries regarding this opportunity, please e-mail Jazmin Vivanco at jvivanco@littler.com with the job title in the subject line

new_jobs.title: Senior Project Manager - Dermatology/Rheumatology
new_jobs.description:
Projects Managers with experience in Dermatology and/or Rheumatology are crucial to the success of Clinical Trials managed by Indero. They are the main point of contact internally as well as externally, ensuring all activities and deliverables are completed on time, on budget, and as expected.

Great project managers go further than creating project plans and following up on tasks. They show leadership to help project teams focus on objectives and deliver results.

We are looking for someone who:

Has at least 7 years of Global clinical project management experience (including but not limited to European regions), including management of all project’s phases from start-up to closure, management of all functional services, vendor management.
Wishes to work for a mid-sized CRO that works on significant multisite trials, including Global Phase III projects.
Is looking to position themselves in an environment where you can grow your career alongside of a growing company.

Impact And Responsibilities

Client interactions

Serve as primary contact for the Sponsor
Provide efficient and timely updates on trial progress
Lead client calls effectively

Project planning

Oversee and actively participates in the preparation of project deliverables such as; study plans, protocol, informed consent form, electronic case report form (eCRF), tables/listings/figures (TLFs), clinical study report.
Participate in the planning and conduct of the Investigator’s Meeting.
Ensure that each site has the necessary material to adequately perform the study (e.g., investigational product, study supplies, special equipment, safety lab kits, etc.).

Quality and risk management

Ensure assigned studies are “audit ready” at all times.
Monitor the quality of study deliverables, (including vendor and SubCRO deliverables) and address issues as they arise.
Manage risk and control measures to assure project quality.
Analyze discrepancies between planned and actual results.
Review and approve responses to quality assurance audits.

Project budget and timelines

Control the project budget, with particular attention to internal hours allocated to all activities.
Identify out of scope activities for change orders.
Proactively manage operational aspects of the clinical trial including trial timelines, budget, resources and vendors. Coordinate tasks and deliverables from all functional departments involved in the project.
Communicate effectively with study team members, functional departments, and senior management.
Manage and report on recruitment status and highlight initiatives needed to meet recruitment timelines.

Project team leadership

Lead the core project team which may include: Associate Project Managers, Project Coordinators, Project Assistants.
Ensure all team members have adequate training on the project.
Work closely with vendors and the following internal teams to ensure all tasks and deliverables are completed on time, according to plans and according to applicable standards: Site Selection, Regulatory Affairs, Data Management, Clinical Monitoring, Biostatistics, Scientific Affairs.

Requirements:

IDEAL PROFILE

Education

B.Sc. in a related field of study to clinical research;
PMP or PRINCE2 certification is an asset

﻿Experience

At least 10 years industry experience including a minimum of 3 years in a CRO;
At least 7 years of clinical project management experience, including management of all projects phases from start up to closure, management of all functional services, vendor management. Experience with mid-size and large studies (>10-15 countries) in multiple regions (NA, SA, APAC, MENA, Europe)
Experience leading multi-centered, multinational phase III clinical trials including project budget financial tracking and forecasting
Experience in one or more of the following considered an asset: study start up, regulatory submission, resource management, supervisory experience, CRA, data management, medical writing, or vendor management;
Therapeutic experience managing dermatology, onco-dermatology, rheumatoid arthritis or oncology trials an asset

Knowledge And Skills

Excellent knowledge of GCP and ICH standards, local country regulations;
Excellent knowledge of Microsoft Office suite;
Fluency in English with excellent oral and written skills, required
Bilingualism (English and local language) is an asset
Ability to work in a team environment and establish good relationships with colleagues and sponsors;
Good problem-solving abilities;
Strong ability to carry out different projects and work under pressure while meeting timelines;

Our company:

At Indero
, you will work alongside brilliant and driven colleagues. Our core values are integrity, commitment, and teamwork
. We offer a stimulating work environment with attractive opportunities for growth and advancement.

As a Project Manager, you will be eligible for the following perks:

Flexible schedule
Vacation
Home-based position
Ongoing learning and development opportunities

﻿About Indero

﻿

Indero
is a contract research organization (CRO) specialized in dermatology and rheumatology. Since its founding in 2000, our organization has built a strong reputation for delivering high-quality research and services that exceed client expectations. Based in Montreal, Indero continues to grow and expand across North America and Europe.

Indero is committed to providing equitable treatment and equal opportunity to all individuals. We will provide accommodations throughout the recruitment and selection process to applicants with disabilities, upon request.

new_jobs.title: Integration Project Manager
new_jobs.description:
At Diverge Health we are passionate about improving health access and outcomes for those most in need. We partner with primary care providers to improve the engagement and management of their Medicaid patients, offering independent practices with specialized resources and clinical programs to close gaps in care. Our teams work to address medical, social and behavioral patient needs, lowering healthcare costs and improving patient lives. Guided by our core values of humility, continuous learning and feeling the weight, our team is on a mission to strengthen communities from within, unlocking people's ability to live their healthiest lives. 

We're looking for an Integration Project Manager to join our team!
You'll own coordination, planning, and execution of a structured, multi-phase integration already underway, a focused, high-impact role for someone who can step into a moving process, get oriented fast, and drive execution with precision. If you bring disciplined project management and genuine change management depth, we want to hear from you.

What You'll Do

You'll inherit an early-stage merger integration and carry it forward, bridging what's already been scoped with the detailed execution plans needed to see it through. You'll serve as the operational backbone of the effort, keeping workstreams on track, enabling executives to stay at the right altitude, and ensuring both sides of the transaction experience the integration as thoughtful, organized, and human.

Key areas you'll add value

Orient quickly to the existing plan, workstream owners, and stakeholders, and drive pre-close milestones to completion alongside our Chief of Staff, who leads this effort.
Build detailed 2026 execution plans across all workstreams and maintain them as a living document, with clear ownership, tracked milestones, and updates as priorities and complexity shift.
Track status across workstreams and facilitate workgroup meetings, proactively surfacing risks and blockers, driving decisions, and documenting outcomes to keep stakeholders aligned and accountable.
Build and execute a change management strategy across both organizations.
Deliver crisp, executive-ready updates and materials for steering committee and leadership reviews, reducing burden on leadership rather than adding to it.
Operate at both altitudes, setting direction at the program level while rolling up your sleeves to execute directly when a task needs it.
Partner with leadership team members to shape the 2027 roadmap, spotting gaps in readiness and coordination as the integration matures.

What You’ll Bring

PMP certification or equivalent project management credential.
3+ years of project management experience, including multiple (2+) end-to-end M&A integrations.
Proficiency in modern project management tooling, including Aha!, Microsoft Project, and SharePoint.
Comfort with high-availability expectations, including responsiveness during evenings and weekends for escalations.
Healthcare industry experience, particularly in value-based care, technology-enablement clinical services companies, Federally Qualified Health Centers (FQHCs), or managed care organizations.

Preferred Experience

Consulting background or experience working in a consulting-adjacent environment.
Systems thinking, with genuine comfort with complexity, interdependencies, and operating without complete information.
Experience bridging technology strategy and operational execution, including partnering closely with technology leaders to align product and systems decisions with broader integration goals.
Chicago-based with availability for regular in-person presence preferred.

Who We’re Looking For

Listen first, orient quickly, and earn trust through follow-through.
Stay steady in ambiguity, turning unclear situations into clear next steps.
Hold yourself accountable to outcomes, knowing that this integration has real stakes for real people.
Bring people through change with empathy and clarity, understanding that how the work gets done matters as much as whether it gets done.
Operate effectively with close initial oversight during a ramp period, receiving that structure as an investment in shared success rather than a signal of distrust.
A strong representative of both organizations' mission, vision, and values in every interaction, every meeting, and every hard conversation throughout this integration.

This is a full-time, exempt, salaried position. Commensurate on candidate experience, the expected base salary range for this role
is $125,000-$140,000.

Fraud Notice

To protect you from recruitment scams: legitimate communication from Diverge Health will only come from @greenhouse.com, @divergehealth.org, @divergecares.com, or
no-reply@us.greenhouse-mail.io
. If you receive outreach from any other domain claiming to represent us, please don't engage, and consider reporting it.

Our Investors

Diverge Health is funded by GV and incubated by Triple Aim Partners, which since 2019 has partnered with entrepreneurs to co-found and launch eight companies focused on improving the quality, experience and total cost of healthcare.

At Diverge Health we believe that a diverse set of backgrounds and experiences enrich our teams and enable us to realize our mission. If you do not have experience in all areas detailed above, we encourage you to share your unique background with us and how it might be additive to our team.

new_jobs.title: Sr Technical Program Manager, Prime Video Advertising
new_jobs.description:
Description

Prime Video Ads is at the center of monetizing the Prime Video experience—delivering billions of ad impressions across Live Sports, VOD, Channels, and Ad Tier. We are seeking a Sr. Technical Program Manager to lead feature development programs for the Channels team. You will drive ad monetization programs, cross-PVA platform features, and end-to-end delivery with external channel partners—coordinating across PVA engineering teams (Supply, Delivery, Signals, Ad Insertion) and partnering with organizations across Prime Video and Amazon Ads.

The ideal candidate brings structure to ambiguity, thrives in cross-org coordination, and has a bias for action. You are comfortable in technical architecture discussions, challenging trade-offs, and balancing business needs versus technical constraints. Sound judgment, negotiation skills, and the ability to influence are essential.

Key job responsibilities

Own end-to-end Channels ad monetization programs—from requirements through launch and iteration
Lead cross-team coordination across PVA engineering teams to align roadmaps, resolve dependencies, and deliver on time
Be the technical liaison between channel publishers and internal product/engineering teams
Champion new features; identify product opportunities and influence stakeholders toward durable solutions
Drive technical design reviews ensuring scalability, reliability, and latency requirements are met
Anticipate bottlenecks, manage risks proactively, and provide clear escalation paths
Communicate roadmaps, trade-offs, and status clearly to cross-functional teams and senior leadership

A day in the life

You will plan and execute high-profile launches—new channel partner integrations, ad format rollouts, and marketplace expansions
You will lead cross-org working sessions with Amazon Ads, Prime Video, and partner teams on technical specs and delivery timelines
You will gain exposure to OTT streaming protocols (DASH, HLS), SSAI, and advertising specs for delivery and measurement
You will manage multiple concurrent programs at different stages—early design, mid-execution, and post-launch optimization
Your success requires strong technical skills coupled with ownership, collaboration, and empathy

About The Team

new_jobs.title: Sr. Technical Program Manager - Open Source, Kiro
new_jobs.description:
Description

Kiro Labs is the public home for community-built projects in the Kiro ecosystem - a GitHub organization where Amazon engineers, and over time trusted external contributors, publish the experimental tools, SDKs, MCP servers, CLI extensions, and skill libraries they build on top of Kiro. Thousands of engineers already build for Kiro every day. Almost none of that work has left the building. Kiro Labs is how we open it up: a governed but deliberately low-friction path that moves internal innovation into the open, where a broader community of developers can find it, use it, and build on it.

We're looking for a Technical Program Manager to build that program. You'll own the mechanisms that turn Kiro Labs from a promising side effort into a durable, scalable incubator: the publishing pipeline, the governance model, the lifecycle, and the metrics. You'll be the connective tissue across the Kiro product team, open source strategy, security, legal, marketing, and customer success - diving deep enough technically to understand what contributors are building, and program-managing well enough to get it shipped and keep the org healthy.

Key job responsibilities

Own the publishing pipeline end to end - Design and run the intake process that takes a project from proposal to public repo fit review, security review, license and trademark review, and repo creation - and relentlessly drive down time-to-publish.
Build the governance model - Stand up the review committee, define the fit, quality, and security bar, establish decision rights and response SLAs, and document the entire workflow.
Manage cross-functional dependencies and unblock contributors - Coordinate across product, open source strategy, security, legal/IP, marketing, and customer success. Own the critical path, clear blockers, and give contributors a single, obvious place to get answers.
Own project lifecycle and org health - Define and operate the active, maintenance, and archived states, health monitoring, and the sunset process, so Kiro Labs stays a curated set of working tools rather than a graveyard of abandoned repos.
Define and report on success - Establish the program's KPIs - projects published, external engagement (stars, forks, issues, and PRs from outside Amazon), projects that graduate to broad adoption, time-to-publish, and growth in external awareness of Kiro and report progress, risks, and tradeoffs to senior leadership.
Scale the operation - Introduce automated quality and health checks, write the SOPs, and reduce manual effort so the program runs on mechanisms

About The Team

Kiro Labs sits at the intersection of product, customer success, engineering, and open source for Kiro. It's the external-facing complement to a thriving internal builder culture: the place where the tools Amazon engineers build on Kiro reach a public audience, and where a nascent external community can start to form around the product. This role brings together partners who have each carried a piece of it - open source strategy, the Kiro product team, marketing, and customer success - under a single program owner accountable for making it work.

Basic Qualifications

5+ years of technical product or program management experience
7+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience
Experience managing programs across cross-functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules
Experience presenting metrics and progress to goal to senior leadership

Preferred Qualifications

Experience developing and implementing KPI goals and strategies based on broader organization goals
3+ years of software development experience, or Bachelor's degree in engineering or equivalent
Experience running open source or developer community programs, including GitHub organization administration, open source release and compliance processes, and open source licensing

new_jobs.description:
Job Description

Join the team redefining how the world experiences design.

Hey, g’day, mabuhay, kia ora, 你好, hallo, vítejte!

Thanks for stopping by. We know job hunting can be a little time consuming and you’re probably keen to find out what’s on offer, so we’ll get straight to the point.

Where And How You Can Work

Our flagship campus is in Sydney. We also have a campus in Melbourne and co-working spaces in Brisbane, Perth and Adelaide. Across our international hubs — including Manila — we empower our Canvanauts with the flexibility and trust to choose the balance that helps them and their team achieve their goals.

This is a full-time, hybrid role based in Makati
.

What You’d Be Doing In This Role

As Canva scales, change continues to be part of our DNA. And in User Voice, that means building quality systems that evolve as fast as our product does.

As a Program Manager, Customer Experience & AI Enablement
within User Voice – Global User Voice Enablement
, you’ll own and evolve the strategy that ensures every user interaction meets our global quality standards. You’ll turn insights into meaningful change — influencing people, processes, product, and AI systems.

This role isn’t just about auditing — it’s about designing scalable, future-ready quality programs that build trust at every touchpoint.

At the moment, this role is focused on:

Owning the end-to-end lifecycle of Canva’s Quality Program — from rubric design to reporting and continuous improvement
Leading large-scale initiatives that improve CSAT, NPS, First Contact Resolution (FCR), and overall service performance
Designing and implementing frameworks that proactively identify risks across human and AI-powered support
Partnering cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, AI, and Vendor teams to ensure insights influence customer service roadmaps
Delivering high-impact weekly and monthly Quality Business Reviews (QBRs) with clear, actionable insights for leadership
Leading global calibration sessions to maintain consistency across internal teams and external partners

new_jobs.title: Technical Program Manager, Customer Logistics Security
new_jobs.description:
Description

Customer Logistics Security (CLS) protects the physical and digital infrastructure that moves every Amazon package. We are looking for a Technical Program Manager to drive security program execution across Operational Technology (OT) and infrastructure environments, coordinating with engineering teams, business stakeholders, and external partners to deliver outcomes that reduce risk at scale.

You will own the day-to-day execution of cross-functional security programs, managing dependencies, timelines, and stakeholder alignment across internal and external teams.
You will establish and run operating mechanisms that keep programs on track and leadership informed.
You will operate in a space where security requirements intersect with industrial systems, network infrastructure, and physical operations, requiring you to build context quickly and translate between technical and business audiences.

Key job responsibilities

Own end-to-end execution of security programs from planning through delivery, managing scope, timelines, dependencies, and risks across multiple teams.
Establish and maintain operating mechanisms (status cadences, tracking artifacts, escalation paths) that create visibility and drive accountability.
Coordinate with internal engineering teams and external stakeholders to align priorities, secure commitments, and unblock delivery.
Identify and resolve cross-team dependencies and conflicts before they become blockers, escalating with data when needed.
Translate technical security problems into structured program plans with clear milestones, owners, and success criteria.
Drive closure on action items, decisions, and deliverables, ensuring programs maintain momentum through competing priorities.
Communicate program status, risks, and trade-offs to leadership in a clear, concise format that enables decision-making.
Contribute to process improvement by identifying recurring friction in program execution and building mechanisms to prevent it.

About The Team

The OT & Infrastructure Security (OTIS) team is part of Customer Logistics Security (CLS). We secure the operational technology and network infrastructure that powers Amazon's fulfillment, sortation, and delivery network. Our scope includes industrial control systems, facility networks, and the security architecture that protects them. We operate at the intersection of physical operations and cybersecurity, which means the problems are tangible, the scale is massive, and the work matters immediately. The team is collaborative, direct, and outcome-oriented. We value clarity over ceremony, shipped results over activity, and people who build mechanisms that outlast any single project.

Diverse Experiences

Amazon Security values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why Amazon Security?

At Amazon, security is central to maintaining customer trust and delivering delightful customer experiences. Our organization is responsible for creating and maintaining a high bar for security across all of Amazon’s products and services. We offer talented security professionals the chance to accelerate their careers with opportunities to build experience in a wide variety of areas including cloud, devices, retail, entertainment, healthcare, operations, and physical stores.

Inclusive Team Culture

In Amazon Security, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Ongoing DEI events and learning experiences inspire us to continue learning and to embrace our uniqueness. Addressing the toughest security challenges requires that we seek out and celebrate a diversity of ideas, perspectives, and voices.

Training & Career Growth

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, training, and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

Basic Qualifications

Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules
3+ years of project management disciplines including scope, schedule, budget, quality, along with risk and critical path management experience
3+ years of technical product or program management experience

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with programming/scripting (Batch, VB, PowerShell, Java, C#, Chef, Perl, Ruby and/or PHP), or experience in Database like NoSQL and experience managing full application stacks from the OS up through custom applications
Project Management Professional (PMP) or equivalent certification
Experience in a logistics/operations environment
Experience in security, infrastructure, or operational technology domains
Experience managing programs with external stakeholders or partner organizations
Experience with risk-based prioritization and trade-off analysis
Familiarity with industrial control systems, network security, or physical security environments
Experience writing narratives or program documents for senior leadership audiences

Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status.

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

You will establish and run operating mechanisms that keep programs on track and leadership informed.
You will operate in a space where security requirements intersect with industrial systems, network infrastructure, and physical operations, requiring you to build context quickly and translate between technical and business audiences.

Key job responsibilities

Own end-to-end execution of security programs from planning through delivery, managing scope, timelines, dependencies, and risks across multiple teams.
Establish and maintain operating mechanisms (status cadences, tracking artifacts, escalation paths) that create visibility and drive accountability.
Coordinate with internal engineering teams and external stakeholders to align priorities, secure commitments, and unblock delivery.
Identify and resolve cross-team dependencies and conflicts before they become blockers, escalating with data when needed.
Translate technical security problems into structured program plans with clear milestones, owners, and success criteria.
Drive closure on action items, decisions, and deliverables, ensuring programs maintain momentum through competing priorities.
Communicate program status, risks, and trade-offs to leadership in a clear, concise format that enables decision-making.
Contribute to process improvement by identifying recurring friction in program execution and building mechanisms to prevent it.

About The Team

The OT & Infrastructure Security (OTIS) team is part of Customer Logistics Security (CLS). We secure the operational technology and network infrastructure that powers Amazon's fulfillment, sortation, and delivery network. Our scope includes industrial control systems, facility networks, and the security architecture that protects them. We operate at the intersection of physical operations and cybersecurity, which means the problems are tangible, the scale is massive, and the work matters immediately. The team is collaborative, direct, and outcome-oriented. We value clarity over ceremony, shipped results over activity, and people who build mechanisms that outlast any single project.

Diverse Experiences

Amazon Security values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why Amazon Security?

At Amazon, security is central to maintaining customer trust and delivering delightful customer experiences. Our organization is responsible for creating and maintaining a high bar for security across all of Amazon’s products and services. We offer talented security professionals the chance to accelerate their careers with opportunities to build experience in a wide variety of areas including cloud, devices, retail, entertainment, healthcare, operations, and physical stores.

Inclusive Team Culture

In Amazon Security, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Ongoing DEI events and learning experiences inspire us to continue learning and to embrace our uniqueness. Addressing the toughest security challenges requires that we seek out and celebrate a diversity of ideas, perspectives, and voices.

Training & Career Growth

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, training, and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

Basic Qualifications

Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules
3+ years of project management disciplines including scope, schedule, budget, quality, along with risk and critical path management experience
3+ years of technical product or program management experience

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with programming/scripting (Batch, VB, PowerShell, Java, C#, Chef, Perl, Ruby and/or PHP), or experience in Database like NoSQL and experience managing full application stacks from the OS up through custom applications
Project Management Professional (PMP) or equivalent certification
Experience in a logistics/operations environment
Experience in security, infrastructure, or operational technology domains
Experience managing programs with external stakeholders or partner organizations
Experience with risk-based prioritization and trade-off analysis
Familiarity with industrial control systems, network security, or physical security environments
Experience writing narratives or program documents for senior leadership audiences

new_jobs.title: Cybersecurity Manager I
new_jobs.description:
Are you looking to advance your career and flex your leadership and IT skills in a fast-paced and rewarding organization? The Cybersecurity Manager I is responsible for designing, testing, and implementing secure operating systems, networks, and security monitoring tools. This role involves managing IT security systems, conducting risk assessments, performing incident response, and overseeing digital forensics. The Manager I will also develop and enforce security controls, participate in security awareness programs, and prepare security reports for regulatory agencies.

As SNC's corporate team, we provide the company and its business areas with strategic direction and business support spanning executive management, finance and accounting, operations, human resources, legal, IT, information security, facilities, marketing, and communications.

Responsibilities

Team Leadership

Lead, mentor, and develop the Security Engineering team, including hiring, performance management, and career growth planning.
Set team priorities, workload, and resourcing to align with the enterprise security architecture roadmap and roadmap milestones.
Own the team's technical standards and quality bar for secure design, testing, and implementation of operating systems, networks, and security monitoring tools.

Security Architecture & Engineering

Partner with the Enterprise Security Architect to translate architecture strategy and standards into actionable engineering plans, ensuring designs are implementable and operationally sound.
Oversee design reviews and secure-by-design practices across infrastructure, network, and application environments.
Direct the evaluation, deployment, and lifecycle management of security tools and platforms.

Risk, Vulnerability & Compliance

Direct risk and vulnerability assessment programs across network, system, and application layers, ensuring findings are prioritized and remediated on schedule.
Develop, implement, and enforce security controls and operational risk mitigations, and track their effectiveness over time.

Stakeholder Collaboration

Act as a key liaison between Security Engineering and the Enterprise Security Architect, senior leadership, and cross-functional teams to embed security requirements into IT project lifecycles from design through deployment.
Communicate risk posture, program status, and incident learnings to senior leadership in clear, business-relevant terms.

Qualifications You Must Have

Bachelor's degree in Cybersecurity, Network Engineering, Information Technology or related Engineering field of study.
7+ years of experience in a related area.
Relevant experience can be considered as a substitute for the required educational qualifications. In the absence of a degree, a minimum of 11 years of related experience is required.
Higher level relevant degree may substitute for experience.
Strong understanding of cybersecurity principles and network architectures.
Experience with risk assessment, incident response, and digital forensics.
Knowledge of technical standards relating to systems security; experience administering UNIX, Linux, and Windows operating systems, experience with large-scale server systems, thin client architecture, system virtualization, and other related peripherals.
Experience with Assessment and Authorization (A&A) requirements as outlined in the National Industrial Security Program Operating Manual (NISPOM), Risk Management Framework (RMF) for DOD, ICD 503, Joint Special Access Program (SAP) Implementation Guide (JSIG) & National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST) RMF.
The ability to obtain and maintain a Secret U.S. Security Clearance is required.

Qualifications We Prefer

Advanced certifications such as Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP), Certified Information Security Manager (CISM), or similar.
Hands-on experience with advanced cybersecurity tools across SIEM, IDS/IPS, perimeter security (firewalls), cloud security, endpoint detection and response (EDR), network detection and response (NDR), network access control (NAC), and data loss prevention (DLP) platforms.
Working knowledge of AI security practices and AI Security Posture Management (AISPM), including identifying, assessing, and mitigating risks introduced by AI/ML systems and their integration into the enterprise.
Experience leveraging AI-driven tools and automation to increase efficiency and expedite security assessments, vulnerability management, and other operational security processes.
Strong leadership, analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
Knowledge of DoD, government contracting and/or public auditing, policies, standards, and procedures.

Essential Functions

Prolonged periods sitting at a desk and working on a computer.
Ability to lift up to 20 pounds occasionally.
Ability to travel as needed.

This posting will be open for application for a minimum of 5 days and may be extended based on business needs.

Estimated Starting Salary Range: $124,771.42 - $171,560.71. Compensation varies depending on a wide array of factors, such as candidates' key skills, relevant work experience, and education/training/certifications. The disclosed range estimate may be adjusted for any applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled.

SNC offers annual incentive pay based upon performance that is commensurate with the level of the position.

SNC offers a generous benefit package, including medical, dental, and vision plans, 401(k) with 150% match up to 6%, life insurance, 3 weeks paid time off, tuition reimbursement, and more.

Important Notice

This position requires the ability to obtain and maintain a Secret U.S. Security Clearance. U.S. Citizenship status is required as this position needs an active U.S. Security Clearance for employment. Non-U.S. citizens may not be eligible to obtain a security clearance. The Department of Defense Consolidated Adjudications Facility (DoD CAF), a federal government agency, handles the adjudicative aspects of the security clearance eligibility process for industry applicants. Adjudicative factors which affect the outcome of the eligibility determination include, but are not limited to, allegiance to the U.S., foreign influence, foreign preference, criminal conduct, security violations and illegal drug use.

Learn more about the background check process for Security Clearances.

If you are mission-focused, thrive in collaborative environments, and want to make our country stronger with state-of-the-art technologies that safeguard freedom, join our team!

Job Description:

An opportunity for a Data Analyst
has arisen within Airbus Defence and Space, Getafe (Madrid).

The selected candidate will join our Data & Analytics Team, acting as a key interface between business functions, our data ecosystem, and requested solutions. The team is multidisciplinary and focused on driving a data-driven mindset across the organization. The jobholder will reinforce our capabilities in transforming large datasets into strategic assets, collaborating closely with various departments to understand their needs, deliver actionable insights, and ensure top-tier data governance in our complex defense and space programs.

Responsibilities

The main tasks of the jobholder will be:

Perform end-to-end data processing, from gathering relevant data from various internal and external sources to cleaning and processing raw data to ensure the highest data quality.
Apply advanced statistical and analytical techniques to extract meaningful insights, draw accurate conclusions from data, and prevent biases in decision-making.
Design and deliver high-impact data visualizations, charts, and dashboards to communicate findings effectively through clear storytelling, while advising users on best practices.
Prepare and present comprehensive reports to share key insights with stakeholders and support informed, data-driven business decisions.
Manage and maintain analytical tools and software ecosystem for data analysis, ensuring data security, privacy, and full compliance with internal requirements and external regulations.
Foster a data-driven mindset by coaching business functions, collaborating with other teams, and actively sharing best practices and techniques with the wider Airbus data community.

Skills

Is your profile aligned to the following list of skills? Apply! We are looking forward to knowing you:

Education: Degree in Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related quantitative discipline.
Experience: Proven experience in data analysis, data preparation, and working with complex datasets.
Technical knowledge:
Strong command of statistics and probability concepts (e.g., hypothesis testing, Monte Carlo simulations, expected values, standard errors, Central Limit Theorem, confidence intervals).
Proficiency in data analysis and visualization tools (e.g., Python/R, SQL, Tableau, PowerBI, QlikSense, or similar software).

Soft skills: Excellent communication and storytelling skills, high adaptability to work in a networking mode, coaching mindset, and ability to act as a bridge between technical and non-technical teams.
Languages: Advanced level in English.
Valuable / Nice to have: Experience within the aerospace, defense, or industrial manufacturing sectors; knowledge of big data technologies or advanced machine learning models.

new_jobs.title: Senior Cybersecurity Analyst
new_jobs.description:
Job ID: 9388

Date Posted:
August 31, 2026

Space Dynamics Laboratory (SDL) is seeking an experienced Senior Cybersecurity Analyst
to join our corporate Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) team. This position will serve as a senior contributor responsible for leading the development and maintenance of cybersecurity documentation and policies, performing assessments, and managing continuous monitoring activities.

The successful candidate will help ensure SDL’s information systems remain aligned with applicable federal cybersecurity and contractual requirements, including NIST SP 800-171 and the Cybersecurity Maturity Model Certification (CMMC). This role requires a strong understanding of cybersecurity risk and compliance, exceptional technical writing skills, and the ability to translate complex requirements into practical, risk-based actions.

This is an opportunity to take a leadership role in protecting information systems that support national defense, space exploration, and other mission-critical work.

Key Responsibilities

Governance, Policy, and Documentation

Leads the development, review, and maintenance of corporate cybersecurity policies, standards, procedures, plans, and supporting documentation
Ensures cybersecurity documentation accurately reflects implemented controls, organizational practices, contractual requirements, and current regulatory guidance
Leads the maintenance of System Security Plans (SSPs), Plans of Action and Milestones (POA&Ms), control implementation narratives, assessment records, and other compliance documentation
Establishes and maintains documentation governance practices, including document ownership, review cycles, version control, approvals, and evidence retention
Evaluates existing documentation for consistency, completeness, and audit readiness, and lead efforts to address identified gaps
Translates technical security implementations and federal requirements into clear, accurate, and defensible documentation

Assessments and Compliance

Leads internal security assessments, control validations, self-assessments, and compliance reviews against applicable requirements
Plans and coordinates assessment activities, including determining scope, identifying evidence requirements, interviewing control owners, validating assessment objectives, and documenting results
Supports organizational readiness for CMMC third-party assessments, government reviews, customer assessments, and other external compliance activities
Evaluates the design and implementation of security controls and determine whether available evidence adequately demonstrates compliance
Identifies compliance gaps, document findings, recommend corrective actions, and communicate results to technical teams and organizational leadership
Serves as a subject matter expert on NIST SP 800-171, CMMC, CUI protection requirements, and related federal cybersecurity frameworks

Continuous Monitoring and Risk Management

Leads continuous monitoring activities designed to verify that security controls remain implemented and effective over time
Develops and maintains continuous monitoring schedules, assessment plans, evidence requirements, and reporting mechanisms
Coordinates with control owners to gather, review, and maintain evidence and artifacts supporting ongoing compliance
Monitors changes to systems, technologies, threats, vulnerabilities, and regulatory requirements to determine their potential effect on organizational risk and compliance
Leads the tracking and management of identified deficiencies, POA&M items, remediation activities, and risk-based exceptions
Conducts cybersecurity risk assessments for information systems, business processes, third-party providers, and proposed technologies
Analyzes assessment and monitoring results to identify trends, recurring issues, and opportunities to improve the organization’s security and compliance posture
Prepares risk-based recommendations and clearly communicates material risks to technical and non-technical stakeholders

Organizational Collaboration and Advisory Support

Partners with information technology, engineering, legal, contracts, and business teams to integrate cybersecurity requirements into projects and operational processes
Provides senior-level GRC guidance during system implementations, architecture reviews, technology evaluations, and organizational change initiatives

new_jobs.title: Sr. Program Manager, Financial Risk Mitigation
new_jobs.description:
Description

This Sr. Program Manager role will lead a program within Financial Integrity Trust (FIT), a team embedded within the Financial Risk Mitigation (FRM) organization. FIT is focused on financial integrity of engagement between seller and Amazon by ensuring a secure, transparent, and trustworthy financial relationship between Amazon and its sellers. It is a critical line of defense, stopping bad actors from profiting while ensuring a frictionless experience for SPs. We track “who” is profiting and “where” Amazon disburses funds, and own “when” disbursements occur. We ensure appropriate controls, verifications, and validations for both charge and disbursement instruments, reducing bad actors’ ability to scale fraud and ensure compliance. We also compute and withhold account-level disbursement reserves, govern payment speed, and recover funds from enforced sellers, preventing unpaid fees and misuse of funds.

Key job responsibilities

Mitigate financial risk and stop bad actors from profiting by building tools and setting policies that control how quickly sellers are paid and disburse. This role will work closely with product, tech, policy, legal, and finance stakeholders and partner teams.
Own and communicate strategic vision, updates, goals, policy changes and roadmap to stakeholders and senior leaders. Routinely author documents: PRFAQ’s, Working Backwards, BRD’s, WBR’s/MBR’s/QBR’s, Program Updates etc.
Deliver results and execute multiple high-visibility initiatives simultaneously. Make data-driven tradeoffs to maintain strategic deliverables.
Operate with a high degree of independence. This role requires a curious, self-starting, fast learner who thrives in ambiguous, challenging spaces.
Set and achieve challenging goals to solve problems. Drive efficiency improvements by eliminating non-value add processes and introducing automation to maximize impact.
Develop solutions that scale in a resource constrained environment. Proactively launch mechanisms and build processes that address future challenges.
Extensively build trust with cross-organizational stakeholders. Use data to influence without authority and drive consensus at all levels of an organization.
Expertly quantify impact with best-in-class analytics and investigation techniques. Advanced Excel skills are a minimum expectation (Advanced SQL is a plus).

new_jobs.title: Sr. Technical Program Manager - Open Source, Kiro
new_jobs.description:
Description

Kiro Labs is the public home for community-built projects in the Kiro ecosystem - a GitHub organization where Amazon engineers, and over time trusted external contributors, publish the experimental tools, SDKs, MCP servers, CLI extensions, and skill libraries they build on top of Kiro. Thousands of engineers already build for Kiro every day. Almost none of that work has left the building. Kiro Labs is how we open it up: a governed but deliberately low-friction path that moves internal innovation into the open, where a broader community of developers can find it, use it, and build on it.

We're looking for a Technical Program Manager to build that program. You'll own the mechanisms that turn Kiro Labs from a promising side effort into a durable, scalable incubator: the publishing pipeline, the governance model, the lifecycle, and the metrics. You'll be the connective tissue across the Kiro product team, open source strategy, security, legal, marketing, and customer success - diving deep enough technically to understand what contributors are building, and program-managing well enough to get it shipped and keep the org healthy.

Key job responsibilities

Own the publishing pipeline end to end - Design and run the intake process that takes a project from proposal to public repo fit review, security review, license and trademark review, and repo creation - and relentlessly drive down time-to-publish.
Build the governance model - Stand up the review committee, define the fit, quality, and security bar, establish decision rights and response SLAs, and document the entire workflow.
Manage cross-functional dependencies and unblock contributors - Coordinate across product, open source strategy, security, legal/IP, marketing, and customer success. Own the critical path, clear blockers, and give contributors a single, obvious place to get answers.
Own project lifecycle and org health - Define and operate the active, maintenance, and archived states, health monitoring, and the sunset process, so Kiro Labs stays a curated set of working tools rather than a graveyard of abandoned repos.
Define and report on success - Establish the program's KPIs - projects published, external engagement (stars, forks, issues, and PRs from outside Amazon), projects that graduate to broad adoption, time-to-publish, and growth in external awareness of Kiro and report progress, risks, and tradeoffs to senior leadership.
Scale the operation - Introduce automated quality and health checks, write the SOPs, and reduce manual effort so the program runs on mechanisms

About The Team

Kiro Labs sits at the intersection of product, customer success, engineering, and open source for Kiro. It's the external-facing complement to a thriving internal builder culture: the place where the tools Amazon engineers build on Kiro reach a public audience, and where a nascent external community can start to form around the product. This role brings together partners who have each carried a piece of it - open source strategy, the Kiro product team, marketing, and customer success - under a single program owner accountable for making it work.

Basic Qualifications

5+ years of technical product or program management experience
7+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience
Experience managing programs across cross-functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules
Experience presenting metrics and progress to goal to senior leadership

Preferred Qualifications

Experience developing and implementing KPI goals and strategies based on broader organization goals
3+ years of software development experience, or Bachelor's degree in engineering or equivalent
Experience running open source or developer community programs, including GitHub organization administration, open source release and compliance processes, and open source licensing

Description

Application deadline: Sep 20, 2026

The US ADC Data Center Security Manager serves as the site security leader at an accredited Amazon Dedicated Cloud (ADC) data center campus. This role owns the execution of physical security, operational security, and information protection in support of classified operations at a fast-paced, mission-critical facility.

You will manage day-to-day security operations at your assigned site, direct onsite security personnel, maintain compliance with government accreditation requirements, and protect National Security Information and critical infrastructure from insider and external threats. You will operate independently, triage competing priorities, own security related projects and deliver responsive support to both internal Amazon teams and external government customers.

This position reports to the Cluster Security Manager and partners closely with Data Center Operations, Industrial Security, the Security Program Management team, and government customer security representatives.

Key job responsibilities

Site Security Operations

Direct and manage onsite security forces to execute daily data center security operations

Create, implement, and communicate security requirements at a large, government-accredited, multi-facility data center campus including oversight of cleared escort operations

Perform and support the operations and maintenance of security hardware and systems deployed onsite, including access control, intrusion detection, and video surveillance

Manage and participate in on-call rotations in support of alarm response, security incidents, escalations, and critical service outages

Provide after-hours management support and participate in emergent event response

Program Security & Compliance

Provide comprehensive security guidance across physical security, operational security, and information protection disciplines

Conduct security incident investigations

Support the classified material program to ensure procedures align with internal and customer security policies

Execute compliance processes consistent with AWS policies, standards, guidelines, and applicable legal and regulatory requirements

Participate in recurring security audits, inspections, and reviews conducted by internal teams and government customers

Draft and review security documentation including notifications, standards, procedures, and concepts of operations (CONOPs)

Physical Security & Risk Mitigation

Proactively identify physical security requirements, potential vulnerabilities, and solutions to sustain and enhance site security posture

Plan, conduct and participate in security response drills and table top exercises

Apply knowledge of ICD 705 (Fixed Facility SCIF Construction), ICD Chapter 7 (Intrusion Detection), Chapter 8 (Access Control), and related standards to site security operations

Coordinate with the Security Program Management team on security design, system sustainment, UL 2050 compliance, and capital improvement projects

Ensure security systems and controls meet accreditation standards and pass government inspection

Stakeholder Engagement & Relationships

Develop and strengthen relationships with internal teams (operations, logistics, engineering) and external partners (vendors, contractors, government customers)

Serve as the primary security point of contact for your assigned site, engaging both Amazon leadership and government customer security representatives

Coordinate with Industrial Security on access eligibility and workforce compliance matters affecting site operations

Coordinate with the Security Operations Manager on cleared escort coverage requirements and scheduling at the site level

Heighten security awareness and engagement across all site personnel through training, communication, and visible leadership

Financial & Vendor Management

Manage security purchase orders and contribute to financial analysis for security requirements

Assist cluster leadership with budget decisions related to site security operations and sustainment

Oversee contract security guard performance and ensure vendor compliance with contractual requirements

Support the extraction of performance metrics from workflow ticketing systems to inform data-driven decisions

Basic Qualifications

Current, active TS/SCI with the ability to obtain and maintain a TS/SCI with polygraph
5+ years of experience in a Security Specialist, Security Manager, or equivalent role requiring interpretation and implementation of physical security and operational security requirements in a government or cleared-facility environment

Groundbreaker. Game changer. Pioneer.

TRC has long set the bar for clients who require more than just engineering, combining science with the latest technology to devise innovative solutions that stand the test of time. From pipelines to power plants, roadways to reservoirs, schoolyards to security solutions, clients look to TRC for breakthrough thinking backed by the innovative follow-through of an industry leader.

TRC's professionals work with a broad range of commercial, industrial and government clients and the communities they serve. We deliver breakthrough solutions that address local needs -- so our clients can better succeed in an ever-changing world.

Working at TRC means tackling interesting, meaningful projects. We pride ourselves on our collaborative spirit, entrepreneurial zeal and agile corporate structure. We recognize that the expertise of our staff is our strongest asset, so we generously reward employees for successful performance and invest in their careers through training and the development of new skills and certifications.

Overview

The Data Analyst will ensure the accuracy, integrity, and compliance of energy efficiency program data and project pipelines and optimize use of program tools and systems. Working closely with TRC management, Trade Allies (contractors), and the client's QA/QC team, the Analyst will be responsible for running comprehensive reports that measure pipeline health, performance and future outlook. The ideal candidate has strong Excel, programming and data review skills, excellent follow-through, sound judgment, and the ability to coordinate across internal teams, contractors/Trade Allies, and client stakeholders in a fast-paced program environment.

Responsibilities

Understand and optimize use of CRM, its process flows, output reports, and dashboards.
Run and maintain Excel-based reports to proactively manage data and ensure pipeline attention and quality.
Analyze project pipeline data to identify trends, outliers, and potential compliance issues; escalate findings and recommend corrective actions to TRC management.
Collaborate with TRC & client management to define, refine, and standardize QA/QC review parameters across the energy efficiency program portfolio.
Develop and maintain customer facing tools and data integration across multiple platforms.
Support short- and long-term forecasting of program production and goal attainment through pipeline data analysis.
Document programmatic findings clearly, escalate issues timely, and recommend corrective actions to improve project accuracy and consistency.
Develop and present PowerPoint presentations to management detailing findings and trends.
Coordinate with internal project teams, planning/reporting teams, outreach staff, management, Trade Allies, and the client to align on requirements, resolve issues, and maintain consistent review standards.
Collaborate cross-functionally with internal project, planning, and management teams to ensure data accuracy and consistency.
Learn, understand, and apply energy efficiency principles and mathematical models.
Provide timely client support with commitment to customer satisfaction.
Apply appropriate principles, theories, and concepts to complete assignments within timeframe required.
Participate in and deliver internal and external trainings.
Participate in and attend Trade Ally events and trainings.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree from an accredited college in a related discipline, or equivalent experience/combined education, with up to 5 years of professional experience. Considered an emerging authority and SME in related discipline.

Strong computer and record-keeping skills: proficiency in MS Excel, programming, and use of Customer Relationship Management (CRM).
Ability to handle a high volume of combined inquiries, workbook, database, and documentation reviews.
Strong attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy.
Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including pivot tables, exception reporting, and data analysis.
Excellent oral and written communications skills.
Team player with a positive attitude and ability to work effectively across different teams.
Ability to work with culturally diverse customers and contractors effectively and respectfully.
Excellent time management and organizational skills
Eligibility to work in the United States.

Preferred Qualifications

The ESGpedia platform powers key initiatives across the Asia Pacific region, including the ESCAP Sustainable Business Network (ESBN) Asia-Pacific Green Deal digital platform and the Asia-Pacific Single Accesspoint for ESG Data (SAFE) initiative. ESGpedia is GRI-licensed.

4.     Deliver Business Intelligence (BI) dashboards that visualize analytical results

Requirements

·       3 years of experience as a Data Analyst
·       Strong written and verbal communication skills
·       Proven analytical skills such as data mining, evaluation, analysis and visualization
·       Demonstrated experience in handling data in relational and NoSQL databases
·       Detail oriented and data driven, strong in problem solving skills

: If you’re wired for growth, this is where the grind turns into pride.

Self-Starters

Curious Builders

Job Summary

The Program Manager will own execution and delivery for our Utilization Review (UR) and medical necessity product line, which is growing rapidly across a widening set of health system clients and use cases. This role is ideal for someone early in their career who has already carried real delivery work and wants to grow into product ownership. The Program Manager will be responsible for driving customer requirements end to end — per-client configurations, feature enhancements, and rollout — while managing the day-to-day interaction with engineering and supporting sprint-level prioritization when client requests compete. This position requires a strong bias toward detail, follow-through, deep comfort operating in Jira, and genuine appetite to learn the utilization review domain from scratch; no prior UR expertise is required.

Own end-to-end delivery of customer requirements across every health system running our medical necessity products, from intake through to the customer actively using what was requested
Track and drive the per-customer configuration work required to bring each new health system live and keep existing ones current
Manage the day-to-day interaction between customers, the product team, and engineering: translate requests into clear, buildable work with real acceptance criteria
Support sprint-level prioritization when customer requests compete
Partner with the AI Transformation (AIT) team on rollout for each health system, and help make rollout a repeatable motion rather than a per-customer improvisation
Feed patterns back into the roadmap: when three customers ask for the same thing, be the person who noticed

Required Qualifications

Bachelor's degree
2+ years of program management, project management, implementation, or delivery experience
Demonstrated experience shipping a real product to a real customer: you were part of a team that carried something from early stage through to a customer using it in production and continuing to use it. School projects and internships do not count here
Direct experience coordinating work with an engineering team — writing up requirements, managing a backlog, driving delivery against a sprint cadence
Deep comfort with Jira as your primary working tool
Excellent written and verbal communication; able to hold a thread across multiple customers and internal teams at once
Genuine appetite to learn the healthcare and utilization review domain from scratch

Ideal Experience

Experience at a startup, or fast growing company
Health tech or healthcare SaaS background, particularly in an implementation, customer program management, or delivery role
Exposure to enterprise or health system customers, and to the reality that every customer wants something slightly different
Program or delivery background with a clear ambition to move into product management
